papers.title: A Systematic Analysis of a Small Optimal Subspace for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: $n$-DAS $\subset \mathbb{R}^p$
papers.summary: The search for a low-dimensional subspace that governs neural network training has been a persistent goal in optimization. Yet subspaces defined by Hessian eigenvalue magnitude, such as the dominant/bulk decomposition underlying Dom-SGD and Bulk-SGD, have repeatedly failed to capture where optimization takes place, and adaptive Krylov-based alternatives built on energy-fraction thresholds show promise but still struggle at lower eigenmodes. We argue this failure is structural: the directions of highest curvature are not, in general, the directions along which training moves. We introduce the dominant aligned subspace (DAS), constructed from a full eigendecomposition of the Hessian but selected by gradient alignment rather than eigenvalue magnitude, as a tool for understanding optimization dynamics and a foundation for designing methods that exploit them. To expose this structure under the hardest conditions, we use physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) as a testbed: differential operators from the parabolic, elliptic, and hyperbolic classes induce severely ill-conditioned, anisotropic loss landscapes. Across Poisson, heat, wave, and viscous Burgers benchmarks DAS-restricted training with a line search matches full-space training even where the projected Hessian remains ill-conditioned, showing empirically that convergence does not require all Hessian eigendirections but only a low-dimensional, gradient-aligned subset. We extend the analysis to Gauss-Newton within the DAS and discuss what this structure implies for future subspace-aware optimizers.
papers.title_ja:
物理情報ニューラルネットワークにおける小さな最適部分空間の体系的解析：$n$-DAS $

mathbb{R}^p$
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、Hessian行列の固有値の大きさではなく勾配との整合性に基づいて選択される「支配的整合部分空間（DAS）」を提案し、最適化ダイナミクスの理解と高速化を図る。物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）をテストベッドとして、楕円型・放物型・双曲型微分方程式の損失関数が持つ悪条件化・異方性のある景観下で検証した。結果、DASに制限した学習は、射影Hessianが依然として悪条件化であっても全空間学習と同等の収束性を示し、収束には勾配整合性の高い低次元部分空間のみで十分であることを実証した。さらに、DAS内でのGauss-Newton法への拡張や、部分空間認識型オプティマイザへの応用可能性についても議論している。

papers.title: ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
papers.summary: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization allocates training budget by predicting how partially observed learning curves will continue. LC-PFN first applied prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) to learning-curve extrapolation, and FT-PFN extended this approach to configuration-aware freeze-thaw optimization with a ten-slot hyperparameter encoder. We introduce In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation (ICICLE), an in-context surrogate that accepts a variable number of hyperparameters through a shared set encoder and is trained on a synthetic prior covering typed hyperparameters, heavy-tailed noise, quantization, and divergence. ICICLE has 1.28 million parameters (8.7% of FT-PFN's count) and produces similar mean-regret trajectories to FT-PFN on LCBench, PD1, and TaskSet. On the 86-task Meta-Album benchmark with 33 hyperparameters, ICICLE reaches lower mean normalized regret than Quick-Tune overall and on extended, with no clear difference on mini or micro. It does so without pre-training or meta-training on Meta-Album tasks, whereas Quick-Tune is meta-trained on related Meta-Album tasks. Our release samples synthetic training tasks on the fly and provides a freeze-thaw scheduler for Ray Tune and an ONNX model for inference without JAX or PyTorch.
papers.title_ja: ICICLE: 曲線学習外挿のための文脈内推論
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、学習曲線の外挿を用いたフリーズ・スロー（凍結・解凍）型ベイズ最適化手法ICICLEを提案する。PFN（事前データ適合ネットワーク）の枠組みを拡張し、可変数のハイパーパラメータを共有セットエンコーダで処理する文脈内サロゲートモデルを実現した。わずか128万パラメータでFT-PFNと同等の性能をLCBench等で示し、Meta-Albumベンチマークではメタ学習なしでQuick-Tuneを上回る結果を得た。さらに、Ray Tune統合スケジューラやONNXモデルを提供し、実務的な推論効率化を実現している。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化とサロゲートモデルの効率化が関心と一致

papers.title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
papers.summary: Neural surrogates for external vehicle aerodynamics are fast alternatives to physics-based computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations. Their foundational limitation is a lack of zero-shot generalization across vehicle classes, which results in an expensive, custom training campaign for each new vehicle design. Similar to pretrained models in other fields, a pretrained surrogate should adapt to a new vehicle class using only a few simulations and stay accurate on its pretraining domain. No prior study has systematically tested this transfer behavior. We conduct a large-scale, controlled benchmarking study on five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates across four independent target datasets. These datasets differ from the source in geometry, CFD solver, turbulence model, and flow conditions. We find that fine-tuning these surrogates outperforms training from scratch in fewer than half of the comparisons and lowers the accuracy of the surrogate on its source dataset. We introduce GeoReplay, a geometry- and gradient-aligned source replay that keeps source simulations resembling the target in training and applies their updates only when they agree with the target gradient. A risk bound separates geometric coverage from differences in the simulated physics, and we prove that every sufficiently small GeoReplay step decreases the target training objective. GeoReplay lowers the source error of fine-tuning in 77 of 80 settings and matches its target accuracy.
papers.title_ja: 車両気体力学におけるニューラルサロゲートの転移性能の測定と改善
papers.summary_ja: 車両気体力学におけるCFDシミュレーションの高速代替手段であるニューラルサロゲートモデルの、異なる車両クラス間でのゼロショット汎化能力の欠如という課題に取り組む。大規模なベンチマーク調査により、既存の事前学習モデルをファインチューニングしても、ゼロから学習するより精度が劣る場合があることを示した。そこで、幾何学と勾配を整合させたソースリプレイ手法「GeoReplay」を提案し、ソースデータセットの精度低下を抑えつつターゲットデータへの適応を促進する。理論的なリスク境界を導出し、GeoReplayがファインチューニング時のソース誤差を大幅に低減し、ターゲット精度を維持することを証明した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルの転移学習と物理シミュレーション高速化の両方に深く関連

papers.title: Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
papers.summary: The rapid expansion of gravitational-wave astronomy and high-precision numerical relativity has created an acute computational bottleneck: direct numerical integration of the Einstein field equations and high-dimensional Bayesian parameter estimation require millions of waveform evaluations that cannot be sustained by traditional solvers alone. Reduced-order modeling (ROM) and surrogate techniques have emerged as foundational tools to bridge this gap, compressing high-fidelity solution manifolds into compact, rapidly evaluable representations without sacrificing physical accuracy. This perspective reviews the mathematical pillars of projection-based reduced-order modeling---including Proper Orthogonal Decomposition, greedy basis selection, and the Empirical Interpolation Method---and traces their operational impact in gravitational-wave data analysis through surrogate waveform families and Reduced-Order Quadratures. We then examine the fundamental approximation barriers posed by slow Kolmogorov n-width decay in non-stationary, transient, and strongly nonlinear regimes, showing how adaptive hp-greedy domain partitioning and multi-scale spectral compression overcome these limits. Finally, we discuss how combining certified reduced-order structures with modern scientific machine learning and sensitivity-aware quantization provides a rigorous blueprint for next-generation detectors such as LISA, Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer.
papers.title_ja: 重力波物理学と数値相対論におけるサロゲートモデリングと縮約順序法：スペクトル表現から適応圧縮まで
papers.summary_ja: 重力波天文学における計算ボトルネックを解決するため、縮約順序モデリング（ROM）とサロゲート技術の数学的基盤と応用をレビューする。固有直交分解や経験的補間法などの射影ベース手法に加え、非定常・非線形領域での近似限界を克服するための適応hp-greedy領域分割やマルチスケールスペクトル圧縮を詳述する。さらに、認証済み縮約構造と科学的機械学習、感度認識量子化を組み合わせることで、LISAやアインシュタイン望遠鏡などの次世代検出器に向けた厳密な設計指針を提示する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと縮約モデル、量子化、物理系へのML適用が関心と一致

papers.title: Replicating chaotic dynamics from sparse sensors with recurrent latent states
papers.summary: Forecasting a high-dimensional nonlinear system from a few point sensors requires an estimate of the current state and a model of its evolution. Reduced-order models usually take the full state as input, so with only sparse sensors they require an auxiliary full-state estimate whose error is inherited by the latent representation. We instead build the latent state from sensor measurements alone, using a shallow recurrent decoder (SHRED) network that encodes a history of point measurements, and train an echo state network to advance that latent state autonomously. We show that the resulting latent dynamics replicate the long-term dynamical invariants of the underlying system rather than merely tracking its short-term trajectory. For the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, the autonomous latent model reproduces the leading Lyapunov exponents of the full system from 25 of 128 state components, using a latent state with 6-14% as many components as the full state. Because Lyapunov exponents are invariant under smooth coordinate changes, this is consistent with the recurrent encoder recovering an embedding of the attractor, in the spirit of Takens' delay embedding theorem. The recurrent encoding also decouples forecast skill from reconstruction accuracy. SHRED reconstructs less accurately than a convolutional autoencoder given the full state, yet it forecasts comparably on the simpler chaotic case and better on the more complex one. For Kolmogorov flow, with sensors at 6% of grid points and a latent state 0.3% the size of the vorticity field, the autonomous model remains on the learned latent manifold over long horizons.
papers.title_ja: 再帰的潜在状態を用いたスパースセンサーからのカオス的ダイナミクスの再現
papers.summary_ja: 少数のセンサーデータのみから高次元非線形系の状態を推定し、予測を行う手法を提案する。浅い再帰型デコーダ（SHRED）でセンサー履歴を潜在状態にエンコードし、エコー状態ネットワークでその状態を自律的に進化させる。Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程式において、全状態の25/128のセンサーから主要なLyapunov指数を再現し、縮約モデルとして機能することを示した。再帰的エンコーディングにより、再構成精度と予測精度が解耦され、複雑なカオス系でも優れた予測性能を発揮する。
papers.relevance_reason: スパースデータからの縮約モデル構築と再帰的潜在空間学習は、ユーザーの関心であるサロゲートモデル・縮約モデル・物理系予測の高速化に直結する高度な手法であるため。

papers.title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
papers.summary: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.
papers.title_ja: QDA: エージェントを用いた閉ループLLM量子化設計
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMの推論コスト削減のための後学習量子化（PTQ）レシピを、AIエージェントが自動設計するシステム「QDA」を提案する。エージェントは候補レシピを生成し、出力のKLダイバージェンスによる高速評価と、繰り返しループなどの失敗検出のための長文生成チェックを繰り返すことで、最適な設定を探索する。さらに、異なるコードベースの互換性を保つPTQ手法ライブラリを提供し、モデルアーキテクチャへの移植を容易にする。4つの推論モデルにおいて、既存の最良レシピより精度を向上させ、大規模MoEモデルでもFP8モデルの精度の98.3%を回復しつつ、既存サービングカーネルで追加オーバーヘッドなしに動作することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM量子化とエージェント設計の両方に深く関連する

papers.title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
papers.summary: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes an edit only when gains outweigh regressions, scoping specialized fixes to prevent over-triggering and guaranteeing non-regression on its gated buffer. At test time, one frozen harness runs in a single pass. Across benchmarks on memory, skill evolution, continual task streams, and domain reasoning, GUARD consistently improves performance without catastrophic forgetting or memory pollution while substantially cutting deployment token usage.
papers.title_ja: GUARD: 後悔ガイダンスによる再帰的自己改善の安定化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、重み更新なしでプロンプトやメモリなどのハーネスを自己改善する再帰的自己改善（RSI）における性能劣化やスキル忘却の問題を解決するフレームワーク「GUARD」を提案する。タスクを実行前のセルフチェックに分解し、方向性のある後悔（regret）に基づいてハーネスの更新を導くことで、新規に壊れた挙動を優先的に修正しつつ既存のルールを固定する。また、Soft-HURT ゲートにより利得が退行を上回る場合のみ編集を適用し、非退行性を保証する。メモリ、スキル進化、継続的タスクストリームなどのベンチマークにおいて、大規模な忘却やメモリ汚染なしに性能を向上させ、デプロイ時のトークン使用量も大幅に削減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計・RAG・効率化の核心を突く手法

papers.title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
papers.summary: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent's memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and $\tau^2$-bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on $\tau^2$-bench. ARISE-Teacher also outperforms GEPA by 4.5 pp on $\tau^2$-bench and 1.4 pp on SOP-Bench. With the deployment model as its own attributor, ARISE-Self still gains 10.0 pp on SOP-Bench. ARISE-Teacher uses 4.0% fewer model calls and 5.2% fewer output tokens at comparable per-task cost (-1.0%).
papers.title_ja: ARISE: 正確性とコスト効率を両立するエンタープライズエージェントのための実用的な自己進化型メモリ
papers.summary_ja: エンタープライズ向けLLMエージェントにおいて、モデル重みの更新なしに失敗事例から学習しメモリを進化させるフレームワークARISEを提案する。モデル自体または教師モデルを用いて失敗の原因を特定し、修正内容を検索可能なマイクロメモリとして保持し、精度向上を確認した上でマクロルールとして統合する。SOP-Benchおよびτ²-benchの14ドメインで検証し、ベースライン比で最大10.9ポイントの精度向上と、モデル呼び出し数・トークン数の削減を同時に実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計・RAG・コスト効率化の核心を突く

papers.title: FACT: Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. However, better draft predictions and longer accepted continuations do not necessarily produce faster generation. To examine this gap, we present FACT (Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training), an experimental framework for studying how drafter training, candidate allocation, and execution conditions jointly affect acceptance and latency. Using a lightweight feature-prediction drafter with a frozen Llama-3-8B-Instruct target under greedy decoding, we first examine how training translates into accepted tokens. Backpropagating through predicted-feature rollouts with greater weight on early steps improves acceptance by 15-24% over uniformly weighted detached training, yet average rollout proxy cross-entropy does not reliably rank drafters by acceptance. Beyond prediction quality, the placement of draft candidates also matters: with a fixed 256-node budget and matched per-depth widths, replacing static allocation with confidence-guided allocation increases speedup over autoregressive decoding from $1.46\times$ to $2.02\times$ on HumanEval and from $1.31\times$ to $1.75\times$ on MT-Bench. This allocation benefit extends to an independently trained drafter, but stronger training does not consistently amplify it, showing that the two improvements do not necessarily reinforce each other. Even these speed gains depend on execution conditions: changing only host-thread settings can nearly eliminate speedup without changing acceptance. Together, these findings show why training and allocation must be evaluated jointly using both acceptance and end-to-end latency under controlled execution conditions.
papers.title_ja: FACT: 投機的デコーディングにおける固定予算配分とステップ間学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMの推論高速化手法である投機的デコーディングにおいて、ドラフタの学習と候補トークンの配分が生成速度に与える影響を分析するフレームワークFACTを提案する。固定予算下で信頼度に基づく動的配分を行うことで、HumanEvalで最大2.02倍の高速化を実現し、静的配分を上回ることを示した。また、予測精度の向上と配分戦略の最適化は必ずしも相乗効果を持たず、実行環境設定が速度に大きく影響することを指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化と効率化の核心手法であり、ユーザーの関心と直接一致する。

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Model Predictive Control via Proximal Policy Optimization
papers.summary: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) enables real-time control of complex nonlinear systems but often incurs substantial computational costs due to repeated trajectory simulations. In this paper, we bridge policy optimization in reinforcement learning and sampling-based MPC to improve computational efficiency through sample reuse. Starting from a KL-regularized distributional formulation of trajectory optimization, we derive an exact performance-difference identity based on a signed exponential advantage function. This identity motivates two algorithms, PPO-MPPI and SPO-MPPI, which adapt proximal policy optimization techniques to sampling-based MPC, enabling multiple optimization updates using previously evaluated trajectories without additional forward simulations. We establish population-level monotonic improvement guarantees for both methods and prove convergence to first-order stationarity for PPO-MPPI under fixed-covariance Gaussian sampling distributions. Experiments on quadruped velocity tracking and quadrotor path tracking demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve competitive control performance at substantially lower computational cost than multi-stage sampling approaches. Our results establish a principled connection between policy optimization and sampling-based MPC and highlight the potential of trajectory reuse for sample-efficient predictive control.
papers.title_ja: 近接方策最適化によるサンプル効率の良いモデル予測制御
papers.summary_ja: サンプリングベースのモデル予測制御（MPC）における計算コスト削減を目的とし、強化学習の近接方策最適化（PPO）手法を適用した。KL正則化された軌道最適化の分布的定式化から、符号付き指数アドバンテージ関数に基づく厳密な性能差恒等式を導出した。これに基づき、既存の軌道評価を再利用して複数回の最適化更新を行うPPO-MPPIとSPO-MPPIを提案した。四脚ロボットやクアッドロータの追跡実験において、マルチステージサンプリング法と比較して計算コストを大幅に削減しつつ、競争力のある制御性能を実現したことを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と制御の融合、計算効率化、軌道最適化に直結する手法

papers.title: A curvature-corrected port-Hamiltonian reduced-order model for dissipative sloshing with contact-line hysteresis in low-gravity tanks
papers.summary: A physics-based reduced-order model unifies curved-meniscus inertia, viscous losses and nonsmooth contact-line stick-slip in a passive port-Hamiltonian formulation for lateral sloshing in cylindrical tanks. Dirichlet-Neumann and Jacobi operators describe inertia and restoring forces, while a convex potential combines bulk, Stokes-layer and contact-line dissipation. Analytical propagation between stick-slip events supports faster-than-real-time simulation of coupled spacecraft translation and sloshing. The viscous closure agrees within 5% with a reference Stokes calculation, and the model reproduces the Henderson-Miles modal measurements and the Cocciaro hysteretic decay. Across 42 drop-tower and ground measurements, curvature correction reduces the root-mean-square frequency error from 24 to 4%. For flight and ground tests from the Middeck 0-Gravity Dynamics Experiment (MODE), frequency errors range from 0.9 to 7.1%, while ideal contact lines underestimate the damping ratios from the MODE fits by 38-87%. One hysteresis width, calibrated on the lowest orbital water excitation, predicts higher orbital excitations and the ground test with normalised force errors of 11-35%, against 149-208% for an ideal pinned line. It predicts 8.5% resonance softening against 7.3% measured, which the tested one-parameter damping laws miss. Uncertain wetting and remaining response discrepancies motivate damping ranges in spacecraft control analyses.
papers.title_ja: 低重力タンクにおける接触線ヒステリシス付き減衰スロッシングのための曲率補正ポート・ハミルトニアン縮約モデル
papers.summary_ja: 低重力環境下でのタンク内液体のスロッシング現象を、物理法則に基づいたポート・ハミルトニアン形式の縮約モデルで記述する。曲率慣性、粘性損失、および接触線のスティック・スリップを統一的に扱い、宇宙機の並進運動との結合シミュレーションをリアルタイムより高速に実現する。42件の落下塔および地上実験データに対し、周波数誤差を24%から4%へ低減し、MODE実験の減衰比予測精度も大幅に向上させた。このモデルは、宇宙機制御解析における減衰特性の不確実性を定量化し、共振周波数の軟化を高精度で予測できる。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと軌道力学（宇宙機制御）の組み合わせであり、高速シミュレーションと実務応用に直結する。

papers.title: Averting `Gravity': Launch Control and the Limits of Collision Avoidance in Low Earth Orbit Operations
papers.summary: As large constellations fill low Earth orbit, the risk of a runaway collision cascade has become a central concern of space operations. Debris population models treat collision avoidance as a fixed input, although the capacity to screen potential collisions and plan maneuvers degrades as debris accumulates. Using a stylized multi-layer queueing network model, we show that collision avoidance capabilities that saturate as the in-custody fragment count increases, can make the orbital shell bistable, with a low-debris and a high-debris equilibrium, and hysteretic. This has two major operational consequences. First, leaving the high-debris equilibrium requires a large cut in launch rates. Second, in the low-debris equilibrium, fragment counts respond with a delay as the launch rate rises past a tipping point. Removing bistability is desirable, and we show that fragment count-indexed admission control can achieve this. The least restrictive such policy lengthens the lag, whereas an exponential tilt of this policy makes the fragment count track its equilibrium with a bounded lag. Furthermore, admitting more launches can reduce the rate of completed missions, and under a unimodality condition a threshold rule on the debris fragment count maximizes this rate at equilibrium.
papers.title_ja: 「重力」の回避：低軌道運用における発射管制と衝突回避の限界
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道におけるデブリ増加による衝突回避能力の飽和が、軌道環境を二安定状態（低デブリ/高デブリ）に導くことをキューイングネットワークモデルで示した。高デブリ状態からの脱却には発射率の大幅削減が必要であり、低デブリ状態でも発射率増加に対しデブリ数が遅延して反応する特性がある。デブリ数に基づく発射許可制御（アドミッションコントロール）により二安定性を除去し、ミッション完了率を最大化する閾値ルールを提案した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・宇宙機運用の最適化と制御理論の応用であり、ユーザーの関心に直結する。

papers.title: Dual-Actuation Emulation of Scaled Relative Orbital Dynamics on a Free-Flyer
papers.summary: Ground-based free-flyer testbeds reproduce the planar motion of a free-floating spacecraft using air bearings, but not the relative dynamics of spacecraft in orbit. We present a dual-actuation architecture that physically emulates Clohessy-Wiltshire dynamics on an open-source free-flyer. Two model predictive controllers run in parallel: one drives the solenoid thrusters with an orbital dynamics model, representing the spacecraft under test; the other drives bidirectional propellers that physically apply the orbital accelerations, continuously updating its reference to account for thruster-induced velocity changes. A dynamic similitude maps the orbital scenario onto the limited floor area and actuation rates of the testbed, letting the spacecraft controller run directly at orbital scale. We validate the architecture on hardware and against a high-fidelity orbital simulation, where the orbital accelerations instead arise naturally, both driven by the identical spacecraft controller. Their agreement indicates that the testbed reproduces the relative orbital motion the controller would encounter in flight.
papers.title_ja: フリーフライヤーを用いた縮尺相対軌道力学のデュアルアクチュエーションエミュレーション
papers.summary_ja: 地上のフリーフライヤーテストベッドで、軌道上の宇宙機の相対運動（Clohessy-Wiltshire力学）を物理的に再現するデュアルアクチュエーション機構を提案する。2つのモデル予測制御器（MPC）を並列実行し、一方はテスト対象の宇宙機を駆動し、もう一方はプロペラで軌道加速度を物理的に付与することで、限られた床面積内で軌道スケールのシミュレーションを実現する。高忠実度軌道シミュレーションとの比較により、このテストベッドが飛行時に遭遇する相対軌道運動を忠実に再現できることを検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学と制御手法（MPC）の組み合わせであり、実務的な検証手法として高関連。

papers.title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check against the model's average behaviour; post hoc, most of these were real but small steps, and 15% of the checkable reports were not found in the model. Of 601 unexpected relationships it read out of the clean models, 11% held in patients randomised later (random pairs 6%; a regression scan's shorter list of its strongest candidates, 28%); after a check on the training data, 33% against 30%. With query access alone, an LLM can describe a black-box model faithfully and find nearly every planted flaw, as a purpose-written script also did; its reports of problems must be checked on the model and its discoveries on data.
papers.title_ja: クエリのみを用いた大規模言語モデルによるブラックボックス臨床予測モデルの監査：埋め込まれた欠陥を用いたブラインドテスト
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、LLMがブラックボックスな臨床予測モデルを説明し、欠陥を検出できるかを検証した。予測値へのアクセスのみを許可した条件下で、LLMは埋め込まれた欠陥の96%を特定し、サロゲートモデルとして高精度な再現性を示した。一方で、LLMが報告した問題点や発見した関係性の多くは、モデルやデータとの照合が必要であり、ハルシネーションや誤検出のリスクも確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのサロゲートモデル化と評価手法が関心に直結

papers.title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
papers.summary: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/
papers.title_ja: DRIFT: 実行時柔軟かつ効率的なエンドツーエンド自動運転のための分離可能推論
papers.summary_ja: 視覚言語モデル（VLM）の計算コスト問題を解決するため、軽量な言語モデル（LM）とサロゲート推論特徴量を組み合わせた自動運転フレームワークDRIFTを提案する。LMから蒸留したサロゲート特徴量を用いることで、推論時にLMをバイパスしても性能を維持できる実行時柔軟な計画モジュールを実現した。Bench2Driveで高スコアを記録しつつ、既存のVLMベースモデルより大幅にコンパクトで計算コストが低いことを実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化とサロゲートモデル活用が両立する手法であり、ユーザーの関心に強く合致する。

papers.title: GridForge: An Open Physics-Informed Digital Twin and Benchmark Suite for UK 11 kV Underground Distribution Cables
papers.summary: The UK distribution-cable monitoring sector is data-rich but framework-poor: each Distribution Network Operator (DNO) collects megabytes of telemetry per asset per day, but there is no public benchmark dataset, no shared reference model, and no commonly agreed evaluation protocol for benchmarking sectoral, data-intensive models for operational decision support; notably for maintenance planning and prioritisation. We address this gap with GridForge, an open-source physics-informed digital twin and benchmark suite for fault diagnosis and prediction, integrating four building blocks: (i) a verified steady state and transient thermal model based on IEC 60287 and IEC 60853; (ii) a calibrated synthetic dataset of 64 cables (covering 320 cable-years) representing four canonical UK 11 kV thermal archetypes and four condition modes; (iii) a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) surrogate that satisfies the algebraic balance defined by IEC 60287 during training and reaches an RMSE of 0.148 {\deg}C on an independent held out set against the reference analytical oracle; and (iv) a five-task benchmark suite that includes three reference baseline models (pure physics, gradient-boosted trees, and the PINN). All numerical parameters are sourced from public standards, the code is licensed under the MIT licence, and the trained PINN converges in only two minutes (as run on the computing platform in Section 10.1), enabling independent verification by DNO engineering and research practitioners. At present only the virtual-sensor task (T4) discriminates between the reference baselines; the other tasks tie or are undefined on this test split, so extending the baselines with task-specific logic is a priority future enhancement. For open validation, the dataset, test sets and models are made available at https://github.com/mlily2024/Gridforge
papers.title_ja: GridForge: イギリス11kV地下配電ケーブルのためのオープンソース物理情報デジタルツインとベンチマークスイート
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、イギリスの11kV地下配電ケーブル向けに、物理法則を組み込んだデジタルツインと評価ベンチマークスイート「GridForge」を提案する。IEC規格に基づく熱モデルと、物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）によるサロゲートモデルを統合し、故障診断・予測の精度向上を図る。PINNは訓練時に物理的制約を満たすよう設計され、参照解析解に対してRMSE 0.148°Cという高精度を達成した。さらに、5タスクのベンチマークスイートと公開データセットを提供し、業界標準の評価プロトコル不在という課題を解決する。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNとサロゲートモデル、ベンチマーク設計が関心に直結

papers.title: Conformally Calibrated Adaptive Computation in Neural Operators
papers.summary: Selecting less computation in a neural operator need not reduce inference time. We study this gap using conformal calibration to choose Fourier modes or channel width per input subject to a fixed error budget. A triangle-inequality envelope bounds all candidates simultaneously; a direct-score rule handles non-monotone candidate errors and, with an input-independent score, calibrates a static baseline under the same marginal guarantee. Under frozen-model and exchangeability assumptions, both rules bound the probability of issuing a prediction outside the budget and abstain when calibration is infeasible. On Burgers and Darcy flow across three training seeds, mode selection reduces active spectral support without a measurable latency reduction, because full-grid transforms and channel mixing dominate the cost. Narrowing channels does reduce Darcy forward cost, but reference-based selection must first compute the dense prediction. An input-only binary width selector avoids that pass and runs at 0.52-0.95 times dense latency; yet static widths calibrated under the same rule are often as fast or faster, and on a separately generated 1,000-example test set they generally achieve higher coverage, while the selector falls below its 90% target in more than half of the settings. Adaptive computation in neural operators should therefore be judged by achieved coverage and complete runtime against a matched static comparator.
papers.title_ja: ニューラルオペレータにおける保形キャリブレーションによる適応計算
papers.summary_ja: ニューラルオペレータにおいて、入力ごとに計算量（フーリエモードやチャネル幅）を適応的に削減しても、必ずしも推論時間が短縮されないというギャップを分析する。保形キャリブレーションを用いて誤差予算内で候補を選択する手法を提案し、Burgers流やDarcy流で検証した。結果、モード選択では全グリッド変換のコストが支配的であり、チャネル幅の削減はコスト低減に有効だが、静的な基準と比較して必ずしも優位とは限らない。適応計算の評価は、達成されるカバレッジと完全な実行時間を静的な比較対象と照らして行うべきであることが示唆される。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータの効率化と評価手法が関心に直結

papers.title: Toward Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Neural AC Power Flow
papers.summary: Growing uncertainty in power system operations from renewables integration, extreme weather, and data center loads challenges the reliability of traditional power flow solvers at scale. Machine learning-based proxies are a potentially promising alternative, but the prohibitive cost of generating training data for large grids makes out-of-distribution generalization a key capability for deployment; currently, models trained on small grids lack that capability. In this work, we systematically evaluate how physics-informed losses, multi-grid training, and perturbation-based data augmentation improve the zero-shot transfer of three graph neural network-based power flow models from smaller systems to a larger, unseen 500-bus system. We find that (1) physics-informed losses improve transfer relative to purely supervised objectives; (2) multi-grid training on smaller systems matches the best single grid but does not close the gap to target-grid training; (3) perturbation-based augmentation on edge attributes improves transfer by up to 54.6%; and (4) random line/generator dropout does not consistently improve performance.
papers.title_ja: ニューラル電力潮流における分布外汎化能力の向上
papers.summary_ja: 再生可能エネルギー統合に伴う電力系統の不確実性に対し、機械学習ベースのサロゲートモデルの分布外汎化能力を評価した。グラフニューラルネットワークを用いた電力潮流モデルについて、物理情報損失関数、マルチグリッド学習、摂動ベースのデータ拡張が、小規模系統から大規模（500バス）未見系統へのゼロショット転移に与える影響を体系的に分析した。物理情報損失は純粋な教師あり学習より転移性能を向上させ、エッジ属性への摂動拡張は最大54.6%の改善をもたらすことが示された。一方、ランダムな線路や発電機のドロップアウトは性能向上に寄与しなかった。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの汎化性能評価であり、関心領域と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Element-Wise Femoral Stress Prediction: A Hybrid Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Finite Element Analysis
papers.summary: Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. The proposed GCN-SAGE-Residual architecture combines graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to model spatial dependencies and stress propagation across mesh elements. We systematically evaluated 14 models in a primary comparison, spanning classical ML methods and baseline GNN architectures, complemented by a targeted architectural ablation that isolates the contribution of each component of the proposed design. Evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid architecture achieves the strongest predictive performance among all evaluated models. The proposed hybrid model achieves the best performance with an R^2 score of 0.8022 and mean absolute error of 2.879 MPa, highlighting the importance of incorporating mesh topology in biomechanical prediction tasks. The proposed framework provides a scalable and computationally efficient alternative for FEM-based orthopedic analyses and fracture risk assessment. The code is publicly available on GitHub.
papers.title_ja: 要素別大腿骨応力予測：有限要素解析のためのハイブリッドグラフニューラルネットワークサロゲート
papers.summary_ja: 有限要素解析（FEA）の計算コストを削減するため、グラフ構造データを活用したハイブリッドグラフニューラルネットワーク（GNN）サロゲートモデルを提案する。GCN、SAGE、残差学習を組み合わせたアーキテクチャにより、メッシュの空間的・トポロジー構造を考慮した大腿骨の応力予測を実現した。14種類のモデル比較およびアブレーションスタディの結果、本手法がR^2スコア0.8022と最も高い予測性能を示した。このフレームワークは、整形外科的な骨折リスク評価において、スケーラブルかつ計算効率の高い代替手段として機能する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとGNNによる物理シミュレーション高速化の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: Stable admissible neural classes and convergent physics-informed neural networks
papers.summary: Residual-based methods, including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), physics-informed Kolmogorov--Arnold networks, and some physics-informed neural operator architectures, approximate PDE solutions by minimizing a discrete least-squares loss formed from the PDE and boundary residuals over a prescribed trial class. This structure is shared by classical least-squares Kansa collocation, whose kernel trial spaces admit an established convergence theory. For neural trial classes, approximation power alone does not ensure that discrete residuals control the continuous solution error. For linear elliptic Dirichlet problems, we extend the kernel-based collocation framework to neural trial classes through elliptic regularity, discrete stability, and consistency. Elliptic regularity supplies the PDE estimate relating solution error to continuous residuals. Discrete stability identifies admissible trial subclasses in which continuous residuals are controlled by a computable discrete loss. This step also quantifies the required number of collocation points. Furthermore, the stability analysis naturally demands a scale-dependent, physics-balanced boundary weight. For the constrained problem, consistency requires accurate comparison functions within the same admissible subclass, a requirement not supplied by neural approximation estimates alone. Specializing to multilayer perceptrons with tanh activations (tanh-MLPs), we construct admissible comparison networks and establish convergence for the constrained residual minimization problem. We further obtain conditional convergence of unconstrained physics-balanced PINNs based on tanh-MLPs under joint network and sampling refinement.
papers.title_ja: 安定な許容ニューラルクラスと収束する物理情報ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）における離散残差と連続解誤差の関係について、カーネル法に基づく収束理論をニューラルトライアルクラスに拡張する。楕円型偏微分方程式に対して、離散安定性と整合性の観点から、連続残差が計算可能な離散損失で制御される「許容サブクラス」を特定する手法を提案する。さらに、tanh活性化関数を用いた多層パーセプトロン（MLP）について、許容比較ネットワークを構築し、制約付きおよび非制約付きPINNの収束性を理論的に証明する。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNの収束理論というユーザー関心の核心に直結する手法論

papers.title: MINT: Meeting-time Indicators for Truncation in Multi-Step Off-Policy RL
papers.summary: Many multi-step off-policy temporal-difference methods handle policy mismatch through products of per-step trace coefficients, leading to a trade-off between variance control and long-horizon signal. The maximum trace length consequently becomes a sensitive hyperparameter. We propose MINT (Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation), which replaces these products with a binary stopping indicator: one until coupled behavior and target trajectories first meet, zero thereafter. At the true value function, the indicator's idempotence yields a variance bound governed by meeting-time survival. For practical implementation, a single sampled action provides a model-free surrogate for the stopping rule, requiring no transition model or mixing-time estimate. We derive separate sufficient conditions for contraction of the state-coupled operator and its practical surrogate under fixed-policy evaluation. On MuJoCo and DeepMind Control tasks, MINT outperforms the reported multi-step baselines; the main MuJoCo comparison uses a common cap without per-task cap-length tuning. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of MINT on Atari 100k, RWRL, and OGBench experiments; MINT adapts the backup horizon to reduce target variability relative to long fixed-horizon backups across tasks and dynamics.
papers.title_ja: MINT: マルチステップオフポリシー強化学習における打ち切り用のミーティングタイム指標
papers.summary_ja: マルチステップオフポリシーTD法におけるトレース係数の積による分散と長期シグナルのトレードオフを解決するため、MINT手法を提案する。行動とターゲット軌道が初めて一致するまでのバイナリ停止指標を用いることで、分散上限を制御しつつ長期的な価値関数の推定を可能にする。モデルフリーなサロゲートルールにより、遷移モデルや混合時間の推定なしで実装可能であり、収縮性の十分条件も導出している。MuJoCoやAtari 100kなどのベンチマークにおいて、固定ホライズン手法と比較してターゲットの変動を低減し、性能向上を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の手法全般および評価手法への関心に強く該当する

papers.title: Thermodynamics of gas giants accreting via shocks: the role of molecular hydrogen dissociation
papers.summary: Within the core-accretion framework, gas giants acquire most of their mass through accretion shocks during runaway gas accretion. The shock thermodynamics---governed by radiative cooling, accretion history, and equation of state (EoS)---sets the post-shock gas entropy and initial thermal state, strongly influencing both observables and subsequent evolution. We aim to build a coupled evolutionary model predicting the initial thermodynamic conditions, intrinsic luminosities, and upper limits on magnetic field strengths of gas giants across diverse accretion histories. We couple radiation hydrodynamics and $\mathrm{H_2}$ dissociation to long-term planetary interior evolution by training a physics-informed neural network (PINN) predictor on 1000 first-principles simulations resolving the shock physics. This PINN provides post-shock outer boundary conditions for MESA to evolve the planetary envelope beyond runaway accretion. The PINN predicts higher post-shock temperatures than the canonical cold-start model, with the discrepancy widening with planetary mass, while post-shock entropy jumps sharply when $\mathrm{H_2}$ dissociates at $\sim 2000$ K. Gas giants evolved with PINN-derived boundary conditions achieve intrinsic luminosities 4--10 times higher than cold-start models. Under optimistic assumptions, the maximum magnetic field strength at $2 R_{\mathrm{J}}$ reaches a few gauss for a $0.3 M_{\mathrm{J}}$ planet, $\sim 100$ G for $1 M_{\mathrm{J}}$, and $\sim 500$ G for $3 M_{\mathrm{J}}$. Incorporating detailed radiation hydrodynamics and realistic thermodynamics into accretion shock models yields higher initial entropies, brighter intrinsic luminosities, and stronger magnetic fields, providing improved constraints on the masses and accretion rates of directly imaged exoplanets.
papers.title_ja: 衝撃波を介して吸積するガス惑星の熱力学：分子水素解離の役割
papers.summary_ja: ガス惑星の吸積衝撃における熱力学を予測するため、1000件の第一原理シミュレーションで物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）を訓練した。このPINNは衝撃波後の境界条件を高精度に推定し、長期的な惑星内部進化シミュレーション（MESA）と結合する。従来のコールドスタートモデルと比較し、PINNによる予測では衝撃後の温度・エントロピー・固有光度が大幅に高くなることを示した。さらに、これにより直接撮像された系外惑星の質量や吸積率に対する制約条件が改善されることを確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）を用いたシミュレーション高速化・サロゲートモデル構築が核心であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Decomposing SGD Dynamics in Neural Networks: Teacher-Induced Spikes and Variance Inflation
papers.summary: We study two-layer neural networks trained by stochastic gradient descent (SGD) on a multi-index teacher model, focusing on how first-layer parameters orthogonal to the teacher subspace affect generalization. We decompose the first-layer weights into a signal component aligned with the teacher and an orthogonal complement, and analyze their joint SGD dynamics together with the second layer in the proportional limit. We show that although SGD updates to the complement are initially isotropic, the training dynamics induce teacher-dependent spectral spikes in the complement Gram matrix. This emergent anisotropy provides a concrete mechanism by which representation variance is amplified, and generalization degrades. To isolate this effect, we introduce Decomposed Dynamics, an analytically tractable surrogate whose asymptotic test-error dynamics coincide with those of SGD. In simulations with a ReLU student, freezing the directions of the orthogonal complement improves generalization relative to training them. Finally, we show that the signal component rapidly aligns with the second-layer weights, revealing strong cross-layer coupling even in this shallow setting. Together, our results provide a dynamical explanation for how feature learning outside the teacher subspace harms generalization.
papers.title_ja: ニューラルネットワークにおけるSGDダイナミクスの分解：教師誘発スパイクと分散の増幅
papers.summary_ja: 2層ニューラルネットワークのSGD学習において、教師モデルのサブスペースに直交する第1層パラメータが汎化性能に与える影響を解析した。SGDの更新により直交成分のグラム行列に教師依存のスペクトルスパイク（異方性）が創発し、表現の分散が増幅されて汎化が劣化することを示した。このメカニズムを捉える解析可能なサロゲートモデル「Decomposed Dynamics」を提案し、直交成分の方向を固定することで汎化性能が向上することをシミュレーションで検証した。さらに、シグナル成分が第2層の重みと急速に整列する強い層間結合も明らかにした。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の理論的解析とサロゲートモデルの活用が関心に合致

papers.title: Split-and-Learn: Decoupled Learning for Reactive Transport in Heterogeneous Marine Sediments
papers.summary: Reactive transport in heterogeneous marine sediments couples flow and multicomponent transport with nonlinear chemistry and evolving porosity and permeability, and its simulation over thousands of years is computationally expensive, especially when uncertain heterogeneity requires many simulations. We develop Split-and-Learn, a framework that keeps the sequential operator-splitting scheme of the full-order model and replaces each stage by a data-driven surrogate with its own structure. Transport is learned on a local data-driven multiscale space, either as a compressed reduced solution map (global inverse atoms) or as coarse-block pieces of the forward operator assembled into a Galerkin or least-squares Petrov-Galerkin system (local atoms). Chemistry is learned through bounded reaction extents with stoichiometric reconstruction, which preserves reaction invariants and nonnegativity. Flow uses learned interface traces and a reduced mixed multiscale solve that enforces coarse-block mass balance. We prove the stability of the split scheme with the evolving medium and bound the error of the learned solver by the accumulated one-step errors of its stages. Numerical experiments in two- and three-dimensional heterogeneous sediment domains show the accuracy and computational cost of the individual and combined learned stages against the full order split solver.
papers.title_ja: Split-and-Learn：不均一海洋堆積物における反応輸送のための分離学習
papers.summary_ja: 不均一海洋堆積物における反応輸送シミュレーションの計算コスト削減を目的に、Split-and-Learnフレームワークを提案する。フルオーダーモデルの逐次オペレータ分割スキームを維持しつつ、各段階（輸送・化学反応・流れ）をデータ駆動型サロゲートモデルで置き換える手法である。輸送は局所マルチスケール空間上で学習され、化学反応は化学量論的再構成により不変量と非負性を保ちながら学習される。数値実験により、2次元・3次元領域においてフルオーダーソルバーに対する精度と計算効率の向上を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと縮約モデルを用いた物理シミュレーション高速化が関心と一致

papers.title: Error Analysis of Deep Learning
papers.summary: This review examines deep learning theory through the lens of error decomposition, systematically addressing approximation, statistical, and optimization errors. We trace the development of error analyses from bounds on individual error components to frameworks that account for all three. Using nonparametric regression and the Deep Ritz Method as dual running examples, we demonstrate how these analyses apply across fundamentally different loss structures. We then review representative analyses in scientific machine learning, generative learning, reinforcement learning, representation learning, and large language models, showing how learning errors affect solutions, distributions, and predictions through problem-specific arguments. Throughout, we clarify which error components are controlled, how they are combined, and what assumptions are needed to obtain guarantees for trained networks.
papers.title_ja: 深層学習のエラー解析
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、近似誤差・統計誤差・最適化誤差の分解という視点から深層学習理論を体系的にレビューする。非パラメトリック回帰とDeep Ritz Methodを例に、異なる損失構造における誤差解析の適用性を示す。さらに、科学機械学習、生成学習、強化学習、表現学習、大規模言語モデルにおける代表的な誤差解析を概観し、学習誤差が解や予測に与える影響を問題固有の論理で説明する。最後に、訓練済みネットワークに対する保証を得るために必要な仮定や、各誤差成分の制御方法および組み合わせ方を明確にする。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMや科学機械学習の理論的基盤を網羅し、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致

papers.title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
papers.summary: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.
papers.title_ja: コブを最適化し、次にカーネルを最適化する：生成型推薦推論におけるビームサーチの最適化
papers.summary_ja: 生成型推薦システムの推論において、既存のLLMサービングエンジンが持つKVキャッシュの冗長アクセスやホスト側オーバーヘッドを解消する手法を提案する。Tree Attentionを用いてビームをシーケンス次元で連結し、事前生成されたマスクや静的KVキャッシュ割り当て、グラフコンパイルなどの最適化を適用する。カスタムカーネルを使用せずにAscend NPU上で最大25倍のレイテンシ削減を実現し、カスタムカーネルを用いた最先端ソリューションと同等の性能を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化とサービング最適化の核心手法を扱い、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{TRACE-MAS}, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. Experiments on five MAS benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE-MAS significantly improves root-cause localization accuracy by \textbf{60.2}\% and achieves consistent gains in task recovery over strong MAS safeguards.
papers.title_ja: TRACE-MAS: マルチエージェントシステムにおける協調失敗の診断と修復
papers.summary_ja: LLMベースのマルチエージェントシステム（MAS）において、エージェント間の相互作用に起因する失敗をより細粒度で診断・修復するフレームワークを提案する。正常な協調実行パターンから学習し、エージェントの状態変化やメッセージ遷移、タスク依存関係の進化における逸脱を検出する。さらに、ソース認識型アトリビューションにより責任ある実行要素を特定し、タスク重要機能を維持しつつ最小限の介入で協調を回復させる。5つのMASベンチマークでの実験により、根本原因の特定精度が60.2%向上し、既存のMASセーフガードと比較してタスク回復率の安定した向上が示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の両方に直結する高度な研究

papers.title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. As for the choice of divergence, we prove that it strongly influences the amenability of OPD to gradient-based optimization. In particular, while the forward KL divergence enjoys a well-behaved objective landscape, other $f$-divergences, such as reverse KL, can suffer from vanishing gradients even when the student and teacher are far apart. Across language model post-training settings, we demonstrate the implications of these theoretical findings for which OPD objective is preferable, highlighting the importance of accounting for the interplay between the student, teacher, and task at hand.
papers.title_ja: どのトークンを、どのような順序で、どの程度の速さで？オンポリシー蒸留目標の理論的解析
papers.summary_ja: オンポリシー蒸留（OPD）において、シーケンスレベルとトークンレベルの目標選択が学習順序や効率に与える影響を理論的に分析した。シーケンスレベルOPDには将来の一致バイアスが存在し、教師モデルにとって確率の低いトークンを優先する逆学習順序を引き起こすことを示した。また、発散度の選択が勾配ベース最適化の適性に関与し、フォワードKLは良好な目標景観を持つ一方、リバースKLは勾配消失に苦しむ可能性があると証明した。これらの知見は、LLMのポストトレーニングにおける適切な蒸留目標の選択に重要な示唆を与える。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・蒸留手法の理論的基礎に直結

papers.title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
papers.summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.
papers.title_ja: SpecLook: 高速かつ信頼性の高いエージェント型MLLMのための推測的観察先選定
papers.summary_ja: マルチモーダル大規模言語モデル（MLLM）のエージェントにおいて、画像のズームインツール呼び出しと推論を交互に行う逐次ループの遅延と信頼性スコアの欠如を解決する。小規模モデルが次の観察（ズーム先）を推測し、その結果に基づいて回答を生成・検証するトレーニングフリーなフレームワーク「SpecLook」を提案する。この手法により、ループ実行なしで回答の信頼性をスコアリングでき、DeepEyes-7BやThyme-RLと比較して最大9.9倍の高速化と精度向上を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化とエージェント設計の最適化に直結する手法

papers.title: Can LLMs Understand What They Predict? Evaluating Latent Causal Structure Inference in Financial Markets
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated through their ability to predict future outcomes, implicitly assuming that predictive success reflects an understanding of the underlying system. However, accurate predictions can often be achieved without recovering the latent mechanisms that generate observable outcomes. To examine this assumption, we introduce LUCID, a benchmark that evaluates whether models can infer latent market structures from event descriptions and historical financial observations. Models generate event-induced causal graphs representing inferred market structure and are evaluated through a reconstruction-based framework. Our evaluation of 6 open-weight and proprietary LLMs shows that adding their generated graphs generally reduces reconstruction quality compared with using historical observations alone, although a few metrics improve. These findings suggest that inferring informative, event-specific market structures from observable evidence remains challenging for the evaluated LLMs.
papers.title_ja: LLMは予測内容を理解しているのか？金融市場における潜在因果構造推論の評価
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMが予測精度を高めるために潜在する因果構造を正しく推論できるかを評価するベンチマーク「LUCID」を提案する。モデルが生成した因果グラフを用いた再構築品質を、履歴データのみを用いた場合と比較して分析した。結果、多くのLLMにおいて生成グラフの追加は再構築品質を低下させることが示され、観測データから意味のある市場構造を推論することは依然として困難であることが判明した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部理解評価とベンチマーク設計が関心に直結

papers.title: Safe to Omit, Worth Omitting? Keeping the Answer and Cutting Latency When an LLM Agent Skips Another's Message
papers.summary: In multi-agent systems, a receiver agent often waits for a helper agent's message (text or its latent KV cache), which can improve performance but adds latency. We study when a receiver agent can skip the message safely (the final answer rarely changes) and beneficially (the time saved exceeds the cost of deciding). Our mechanism reads the receiver agent's confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold at which, with high probability, at most 5% of skipped answers change; if none passes, the system keeps communicating. We test it on OpenBookQA, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro with three Qwen model pairs, on cross-family agents, and on SQuAD and GSM8K. Four insights emerge. First, oracle headroom is weak evidence that messages help: control inputs without answer-specific content, matched to change answers as often as real messages, reproduce a median 76% of the oracle's gain. Second, whether a message can be skipped depends on how often and how predictably it alters the answer, not on its accuracy; every certified KV-cache path is less accurate than the receiver agent alone. Third, where text messages help, skipping keeps most of their gain: on unseen questions in the four such settings, the policies skip 59 to 80% and keep an estimated 76 to 95% of the gain. In two prospective tests with all rules fixed in advance, our mechanism skips a three-agent system's verifier on 39.9% of sealed questions, keeping 12.55 of its 12.80-point gain, and a 32B helper on 68.4% of held-out questions, keeping its whole gain. Fourth, safety does not determine efficiency: at batch size one, skipping text saves hundreds of milliseconds per query and skipping KV cache far less. Certification extends to SQuAD but not to GSM8K. In eleven tests on unseen questions, every certified policy we could test kept its change rate's 95% upper bound below 5% under our answer parsers.
papers.title_ja: 省略しても安全か、省略する価値があるか？LLMエージェントが他者のメッセージをスキップする際の回答保持とレイテンシ削減
papers.summary_ja: マルチエージェントシステムにおいて、受信側エージェントがヘルパーからのメッセージ（テキストやKVキャッシュ）を安全かつ有益にスキップできる条件を研究した。受信側の信頼度を用いた有限サンプル検定により、回答が変更される確率を5%以下に抑える閾値を証明し、条件を満たさない場合は通信を維持する仕組みを提案した。OpenBookQAやMMLU-Proなどのベンチマークで検証し、メッセージの精度ではなく回答変更の予測可能性がスキップ可否を決定することを示した。テキストメッセージのスキップは数百ミリ秒のレイテンシ削減に寄与する一方、KVキャッシュのスキップは効率化効果が限定的であることが判明した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と推論高速化・効率化の両方に直接関連する手法

papers.title: JEPA as a Transferable Optimizer: Learning and Understanding Black-Box Optimization from Reward-Agnostic Pretraining
papers.summary: Black-box optimization evaluates candidates through simulations, rollouts, or experiments, often without gradients. Learned optimizers are usually judged by whether they outperform existing methods. We ask a complementary question: what information does a learned optimizer use from its search history? We introduce JEPA-PS (JEPA Policy Search), based on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture. It is pretrained on random rollouts using parameter vectors and scalar returns. Its latent-prediction objective predicts the next point in an optimization trajectory rather than its reward or gradient, allowing us to examine what was tried and how well it performed. At test time, JEPA-PS reads a short evaluation history and proposes a candidate in one forward pass, without task descriptions, reward shaping, or test-time gradients. We evaluate it on 15 control environments against 12 optimizers, including evolutionary methods, Bayesian optimization, CMA-ES, and an LLM optimizer. JEPA-PS is competitive with tuned classical baselines and outperforms the LLM optimizer by more than 2x on Swimmer at 71x lower per-step cost. It also transfers zero-shot to environments excluded from pretraining. Null-model comparisons and decoder-training ablations indicate that its latent representation carries information beyond simple history statistics; every trained decoder variant performs worse than the default frozen representation. Our main finding is that the history JEPA-PS uses depends on the task. On smooth landscapes it uses the full trajectory, whereas on rugged landscapes the best-seen point carries nearly all the signal. This memory requirement has a weak positive correlation with fitness-distance correlation (FDC; r=0.112, n=7), while an independent reward-ordering sensitivity probe does not corroborate the relationship (r=-0.024, n=7). Code: https://github.com/mdebnath22/jepa-props.
papers.title_ja: JEPAを転移可能な最適化器として：報酬非依存事前学習によるブラックボックス最適化の学習と理解
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) を活用したブラックボックス最適化アルゴリズム「JEPA-PS」を提案する。報酬や勾配ではなく、最適化軌道内の次の点を予測する潜在予測目標を用いることで、検索履歴からどのような情報を抽出しているかを分析可能にする。15つの制御環境での評価により、調整済みの古典的ベースラインと競争力を持ち、LLM最適化器を大幅に上回る性能と低コストを実証した。さらに、事前学習に含まれない環境へのゼロショット転移能力も示し、タスクの地形（滑らかさ）に応じて利用する履歴情報が変化するメカニズムを解明した。
papers.relevance_reason: ブラックボックス最適化とLLM比較、事前学習による転移が関心に合致

papers.title: Toaster: Nonlinear Memory from Cascaded Linear Memories and Target Propagation
papers.summary: Recurrent memories let language models process long sequences with a fixed-size state. Linear memories such as DeltaNet and KDA store one matrix and take one delta-rule step per token. The product of a chunk of such steps has an exact WY form, so they train fast. Deep memories such as TTT-MLP and Titans store a small MLP, which can hold maps that no matrix can, but their update has no WY form. Toaster bridges the two by building on a known fact: a gradient step on a linear layer is a delta-rule write. It builds a two-layer nonlinear memory from two linear memories with an activation between them. We use target propagation to give the hidden memory its values by projecting the output error back through the second memory. Given a chunk's cross-layer signals, approximated once per chunk, each layer can then run on an unmodified delta-rule kernel. Our default runs this kernel on the output layer and updates the hidden layer once per chunk. Running it on both layers gives a better model in our ablation. At matched backbones and training-token budgets, Toaster has lower loss than KDA at all five tested sizes (0.2B-1.6B non-embedding parameters) on both C4 and PG19. Its C4 perplexity also matches or slightly improves on the attention baseline at every size. At 1.2B it is also below Titans. In a 3:1 hybrid with global attention, the Toaster hybrid has the lowest perplexity of the four hybrids tested, and it is 0.18 (C4) and 0.44 (PG19) below the attention baseline. At the largest size, Toaster's mean three-shot accuracy on 13 tasks is 51.84%, compared with 50.52% for KDA and 50.04% for Titans. In length extrapolation, Toaster's loss stays below KDA's up to 20K tokens (5x the training length). On the 145M backbone, at a hidden width matched to Titans' memory, Toaster takes at most 1.33x KDA's training-step time and is 2.8-5.5x faster than the tested Titans configurations at 32K context.
papers.title_ja: Toaster: 直列接続された線形メモリとターゲット伝播による非線形メモリ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、線形メモリ（DeltaNet等）の高速なWY形式更新と、深層メモリ（Titans等）の表現力の両立を目的とした新しい再帰型メモリアーキテクチャ「Toaster」を提案する。2層の線形メモリを活性化関数で挟み、ターゲット伝播を用いて隠れ層の値を決定することで、既存のデルタルールカーネルを修正せずに非線形メモリを実現する。0.2B〜1.6Bパラメータ規模でKDAやTitansと比較し、C4およびPG19データセットにおいて低い損失とパープレキシティを示す。また、32KコンテキストにおいてTitansより2.8〜5.5倍高速であり、長さ外挿性能もKDAを上回ることを実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論高速化・効率化と長文処理の両立という関心に直結する手法

papers.title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.
papers.title_ja: コミュニケーション型オンポリシー蒸留：長期的タスクにおけるブラックボックス教師モデルの能力を対話を通じて蒸留する手法
papers.summary_ja: ブラックボックスな教師モデルからログアウトを介さずに能力を移転するための新しい蒸留手法「COPD」を提案する。学生モデルがタスク実行中に自然言語で教師に相談し、その成功した対話履歴を参照として用いることで、オンポリシー自己蒸留と強化学習を統合的に実施する。CAMG-IIベンチマークにおいて既存のブラックボックスOPDベースライン比で2.46倍の性能向上を達成し、Terminal-BenchやSWE-Bench Proなど他のエージェントタスクへも汎化することが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と強化学習の融合であり、ユーザーの関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: Evaluating Governed LLM-Driven ML Experimentation: Lifecycle, Provenance, and Failure Metrics
papers.summary: Autonomous agents that run ML experiments are usually judged by the best score they reach. That score says nothing about how it was reached: whether the agent stayed within the files it was allowed to edit, whether failed trials were kept or silently dropped, and whether each keep or discard decision can be traced to its evidence. We propose evaluating such systems on their experimental process as well as their outcome, and we build a governed harness that makes this possible. A control plane, not the LLM that proposes changes, owns each trial's lifecycle, checks its edit scope, decides keep or discard, and appends one record per trial to an append-only ledger. Governance metrics such as the invalid-action rate, the repeated-bad rate and provenance completeness are computed from that ledger. Across six ML tasks, from synthetic logistic regression to language-model training, and 1,445 trials, the same contract applied unchanged. The ledger exposed failures that a task score hides: a no-memory arm in which all 120 trials failed, a benchmark adapter whose bounded proposals ran out, and a reset failure that reproducibility hashes revealed, after which the affected campaigns were rerun. In a matched counterfactual, a loop that logs only successful trials left no record of 43 of 50 trials, while the governed ledger recorded all 50. Memory ablations show that memory's effect on repeated bad proposals depends on the task. We release the ledgers of all 1,445 trials, so that every number reported for them can be recomputed.
papers.title_ja: ガバナンス付きLLM駆動のML実験の評価：ライフサイクル、プロベナンス、および失敗メトリクス
papers.summary_ja: 自律エージェントによる機械学習実験の評価において、単なる最終スコアではなく、編集範囲の遵守や試行の追跡可能性（プロベナンス）といったプロセスの健全性を重視する枠組みを提案する。LLMとは独立した制御プレーンが試行のライフサイクルを管理し、追記専用台帳に記録することで、無効アクション率や繰り返し失敗率などのガバナンス指標を算出可能にする。6つのMLタスクと1,445回の試行を通じて、この契約が適用可能であることを示し、スコアでは隠蔽される失敗（メモリ欠如による全滅や適応器の提案枯渇など）を台帳から特定した。成功した試行のみ記録する従来の手法と比較し、ガバナンス付き台帳が全試行を正確に記録し、再現性を担保する優位性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の両方に深く関連し、実務的なガバナンス指標を提供する。

papers.title: A Differential Theory of Quality-Resource Trade-offs for AI Model Selection: The Multiresource Frontier and Its Minimax Price
papers.summary: Comparing AI models across resource budgets yields quality-resource frontiers relating error to latency, parameter count, training compute, and energy. Offset power laws summarize such frontiers, but their fitted parameters reveal neither the price-independent geometry nor the manner in which trade-offs extend across several resource channels. This paper addresses both gaps by developing a differential theory in which this structure is made explicit. Each frontier admits a price-independent plane-curve representation relating the effective number of active resource channels, $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = s^2/\kappa$ (squared slope over curvature), to the remaining log-error depth, $\Delta S = \ln(\varepsilon/\varepsilon_{\infty})$. This representation separates intrinsic shape from the scale and origin of the resource axis. Complete monotonicity and divisibility yield differential inequalities and frontier bounds. When each of $N$ resources contributes one active channel, the theory gives the parameter-free operating rule $N_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1$ in delivered units and derives minimax resource prices $\lambda^{\star}_i = \alpha_i/(N+1)$ with an exact worst-case regret of $\ln(N+1)$ nats. The results make it possible to interpret measured frontiers and compare resource costs without hand-chosen exchange rates. The theory is evaluated on 117 published frontiers and implemented in the open-source package nn-rank, which derives prices from measured quality and cost, ranks candidates, and reports supported choices and minimax regret: https://github.com/ABrain-One/nn-rank
papers.title_ja: AIモデル選択における品質とリソースのトレードオフに関する微分理論：マルチリソースフロンティアとそのミニマックス価格
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、AIモデルの品質とリソース（レイテンシ、パラメータ数、計算量など）のトレードオフを記述する微分理論を提案する。価格に依存しない幾何学的表現を用いることで、リソース軸のスケールや原点から独立した本質的な形状を分離し、完全単調性や可分性から微分不等式を導出する。さらに、Nつのリソースが等しく寄与する場合の最適運用ルールと、最悪ケースの後悔を最小化するミニマックス価格をパラメータフリーで導出する。この理論は117件の公開フロンティアで検証され、測定された品質とコストから価格を導出し候補をランキングするオープンソースパッケージnn-rankとして実装されている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と評価手法の理論的基盤を提供し、実務的なモデル選択ツールを伴うため。

papers.title: Implementing Binary Transformers with Approximate Memories with Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) Protection
papers.summary: Quantization is an effective technique to reduce memory storage, computation complexity and power for Transformers, and the binarization of the weights is important for meeting these requirements. Approximate memory can further reduce the power for memory, but it also introduces errors. Current research for binary Transformers focuses on task performance, but the model dependable operation against errors on the memory has not been well studied. In this paper, we first evaluate the dependability of binary Transformers with the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) as a case study. A large accuracy loss occurs only at high Bit Error Rates (e.g. BER = 5% or 10%). Then we propose a novel Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) scheme to protect the binary weights at very low overhead. This scheme exploits the invariance of Transformers to permutations in the rows and columns to group the critical weights and perform selective protection on those weights. Simulation results show that PIES can recover most of the performance loss caused by bit errors at BERs as high as 10%, at an overhead significantly lower than traditional error correction schemes. These results confirm the feasibility of running binary Transformers using approximate memory with aggressive voltage scaling on resource-limited low power edge devices. The code for PIES is released on github (https://github.com/YangZhutian/binary-transformer-prefix-repair).
papers.title_ja: 置換不変性を活用した選択的保護（PIES）による近似メモリ付きバイナリTransformerの実装
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、Transformerの重みをバイナリ化し、低電力エッジデバイス向けに近似メモリ（Approximate Memory）と組み合わせる際の信頼性を評価する。高ビットエラー率（BER 5-10%）下での精度劣化に対し、Transformerの行列置換に対する不変性を活用して重要重みをグループ化し、選択的に保護するPIES手法を提案する。シミュレーションにより、従来の誤り訂正より大幅に低いオーバーヘッドで、BER 10%までの性能損失を回復できることを示し、資源制約環境での実用性を確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの量子化・効率化と推論高速化の観点で高度に関連する

papers.title: When Does Subspace Direction Matter for LoRA? Regime Analysis of the Magnitude Principle in Few-Shot Adaptation
papers.summary: We show that the importance of a LoRA adapter's initial input-subspace direction is regime-dependent, and we characterize this dependence in theory and experiment. This refines the recent view that spectral initializers help through update magnitude alone. Direction matters most when labeled data are scarce relative to the representation dimension and the activation subspace used for initialization captures supervised task structure. In this regime, the adapter's row span remains sensitive to its starting point, making task-aligned initialization especially useful. A spiked-covariance perturbation analysis characterizes the finite-sample stability of the estimated subspace. A first-step analysis of LoRA training explains why the subspace's alignment with the task matters and motivates an alignment coefficient $\rho$ that closely tracks gains across classification tasks. We test this account with PivotLoRA, which initializes adapters from activation PCA at prediction-relevant positions and applies one output-preserving orthogonal pivot early in training. In few-shot BERT-base classification, PivotLoRA achieves the best average rank among 13 methods and improves over vanilla LoRA in 29 of 30 settings, even though it starts from a smaller input-factor initialization norm. Additional classification experiments extend the evaluation to 7B and 8B Llama decoders. Classification gains diminish with more labeled data, consistent with the proposed regime dependence. A targeted extension to completion-only reasoning also shows improvements on GSM8K and StrategyQA. These findings identify conditions under which initialization direction matters, with subspace-task alignment offering a low-cost diagnostic before training for classification.
papers.title_ja: LoRAにおいて部分空間の方向が重要になるのはいつか？少ショット適応における大きさ原理のレジーム分析
papers.summary_ja: LoRA適応器の初期部分空間方向の重要性がデータ量と表現次元の比に依存することを理論・実験で示した。ラベルデータが少ない場合、タスク構造を捉えた初期化が有効であり、スパイク共分散解析と初歩分析によりその安定性と理由を説明する。予測関連位置の活性化PCAから初期化し、直交ピボットを適用するPivotLoRAを提案し、少ショットBERT分類で13手法中最高平均ランクを達成した。Llama 7B/8Bでも分類性能向上を確認し、データ量増加に伴い効果が減衰するレジーム依存性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・LoRA最適化・少ショット適応の手法論であり関心と一致

papers.title: Why Sub-4-Bit Vision CNNs Collapse and Where Mixed-Precision Recovery Stops
papers.summary: Deep vision models operating in resource-constrained environments depend heavily on low-bit quantization, yet compressing weights below 4 bits frequently induces catastrophic accuracy collapse. While mixed-precision recovery strategies aim to rescue accuracy by selectively retaining high-precision parameters, the fundamental mechanics of where and why these models collapse remain poorly understood. In this study, we systematically analyze the anatomy of quantization collapse across standard Vision CNNs (including ResNet and EfficientNet backbones) evaluated on the full 50,000-image ImageNet-1k validation set. First, we map the exact progression of degradation, demonstrating that collapse is highly non-linear and concentrated in late-stage pointwise projections and depthwise layers. Second, we introduce a structured, multi-step recovery waterfall that evaluates selective integer precision (INT4/INT8) and selective floating-point scales. We show that keeping less than 5% of critical layer activations in 8-bit precision recovers up to 92% of the accuracy lost during aggressive sub-4-bit compression. Finally, we bridge the hardware reality gap by evaluating deployment performance on standard ARM and x86 CPU architectures. We show that while low-bit quantization reduces memory storage requirements, standard runtime software bit-unpacking introduces a 1.48x to 21.5x execution slowdown depending on batch size, highlighting a critical trade-off between model footprint and actual edge throughput. Our findings provide a practical blueprint for navigating the limits of sub-4-bit deployment without sacrificing hardware performance.
papers.title_ja: サブ4ビットビジョンCNNが崩壊する理由と、混合精度復元が効かなくなる限界
papers.summary_ja: 低ビット量子化による深層ビジョンモデルの精度崩壊メカニズムを、ResNetやEfficientNetを用いて体系的に分析した。崩壊は後期のpointwise projectionやdepthwise層に非線形的に集中することを示し、重要層の5%未満を8ビット精度で保持するだけで失われた精度の92%を回復できることを実証した。さらにARMやx86環境での実測により、低ビット化はメモリ削減に有効だが、ランタイムのビットアンパッキングにより最大21.5倍の処理速度低下が生じるというトレードオフを明らかにした。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化の基盤となる量子化・推論高速化の知見が直接関連する

papers.title: PhysDial: Adapting Pretrained Video Models for PDE Simulation under Changing Physical Conditions
papers.summary: Simulating how physical systems respond to changing conditions is central to control, design, and scenario studies. To our knowledge, prior PDE foundation models have not been trained or evaluated on changes within trajectories. Our counterfactual test measures how far predictions move toward a changed solver branch from the same state. Models trained on fixed conditions follow changes only partly. A PDE foundation model given a condition input after pretraining barely responds. PhysDial adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer to eight two-dimensional PDE families. Coefficients enter with the noise level, condition fields as reference frames, and equation text as a prompt. In Kolmogorov flow, switches within trajectories account for about 5% of the training samples. At matched compute, they halve the error after a change in forcing wavenumber or amplitude. A few trajectories at new amplitudes more than halve extrapolation error. Without physics pretraining, PhysDial matches or exceeds PDE foundation models under training conditions on two turbulent flows. At step 64 on the Kolmogorov test split, PhysDial has 1.07 times the solver's small-scale energy and Walrus 7.1 times. Our experiments suggest that a learned simulator uses a condition only as far as its training data make that condition necessary for prediction. Learning from trajectories that diverge under intervention can help scientific simulators predict what would happen if a system's forcing or parameters changed.
papers.title_ja: PhysDial: 物理条件の変化下でのPDEシミュレーションに向けた事前学習済み動画モデルの適応
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、事前学習済み動画拡散モデルを8つの2次元偏微分方程式（PDE）族のシミュレーションに適用する手法「PhysDial」を提案する。従来のPDE基盤モデルが軌道内の条件変化（反事実的変化）に対応しにくい問題を指摘し、係数や条件フィールド、方程式テキストをプロンプトとして組み込むことで、強制波数や振幅の変化に対する予測精度を向上させる。Kolmogorov流において、軌道内のスイッチングを含む学習により、変化後の誤差を半減し、新しい振幅への外挿誤差も大幅に低減した。物理事前学習なしでも、乱流2種において既存のPDE基盤モデルと同等以上の性能を示し、介入下で分岐する軌道からの学習が科学的シミュレータの汎化能力を高めることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PDEシミュレーションとニューラルネットの融合であり、サロゲートモデル・物理情報学習の関心に直結する。
