papers.title: Synthesizing hyperspectral Data using generative Models to train spectral Unmixing Methods for low-cost Crop Residue Cover Mapping
papers.summary: The spectral range of the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral Mapping (FINCH), developed by the University of Toronto Aerospace Team's Space System Division, poses significant challenges for hyperspectral unmixing to determine crop residue cover fractional abundances. The severe lack of standard indices necessitates the use of complex, data-driven unmixing models. Complex unmixing models require dense, well-distributed manifolds, whereas ground-truth datasets are sparse and expensive. To better leverage the information content in existing ground-truth datasets, this study presents a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, contrasting with traditional single-model unmixing pipelines. This decoupling enables the inclusion of physical prior knowledge about spectra, which is not natively accessible to unmixing models, thereby artificially expanding the dataset to serve as a Monte Carlo approximation of the population risk. To test this hypothesis, we have proposed two generator models: a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers (GD-Streamline) and a Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder (TCVAE), and two unmixing models: Multi-Layered Perceptrons (MLP) and Fourier Neural Operators (FNO). The results of the study indicate a need for rigorous integration and introduction of spectral priors within the scope of the proposed decoupling framework to prevent domain and mode collapse and hallucination by the generator models; otherwise, this leads to falsely approximated data manifolds, ultimately resulting in unsatisfactory and out-of-distribution unmixing performance.
papers.title_ja: 生成モデルによるハイパースペクトルデータ合成と、低コストな作物残渣被覆マッピングのためのスペクトルアンミキシング手法の学習
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、衛星による作物残渣被覆マッピングにおいて、希少な実測データを活用するため、条件付き生成モデルを用いたスペクトルデータ合成フレームワークを提案する。生成モデルとして1D条件付きU-NetとDual-Path Transformer CVAE、アンミキシングモデルとしてMLPとFourier Neural Operators (FNO) を比較検討した。結果、生成モデルに物理的先行知識を厳密に統合しないと、ドメイン崩壊やハルシネーションにより誤ったデータマニホールドが生成され、分布外性能が低下することが明らかになった。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと生成モデルの活用、ハルシネーション対策が関心に合致

papers.title: A probabilistic analysis of the Brumadinho tailings dam-breach using uncertainty quantification and global sensitivity analysis
papers.summary: On 25th January 2019, Dam B1 in Brumadinho, Brazil, suddenly collapsed and produced a catastrophic tailings flow with severe human, environmental and infrastructural consequences. Previous numerical back-analyses of the tailings flow have relied on deterministic approaches, which provide useful reference results but do not explicitly incorporate uncertainty associated to rupture hydrograph and tailings' physical properties. This work presents a probabilistic approach to study the tailings dam-breach flow caused by the rupture of Dam B1, focusing on the quantification and interpretation of the effects of input uncertainty on hazard-related hydrodynamical outputs. Deterministic data was obtained through HEC-RAS v6.6 by considering tailings as an one-phase Bingham fluid. The probabilistic framework combines dimensionality reduction, metamodeling and flooding classification to perform fast prediction of unexplored input scenarios. It allows to obtain data distributions that reflect output uncertainty and to estimate variance-based sensitivity indices to quantify the influence of input uncertainty over output variability. Results show that uncertainty is strongly dependent on time and spatial location. Hydrograph-related parameters mainly control the timing and magnitude of the early flow, whereas yield stress becomes more influential in regions associated with flow attenuation, spreading and possible arrest. Overall, the framework provides probabilistic hazard estimates and insights into the physical mechanisms governing the dynamics of tailings flow.
papers.title_ja: 不確実性定量化と全局的感度分析を用いたブルマディンゴ尾鉱ダム決壊の確率論的分析
papers.summary_ja: ブラジルのブルマディンゴ尾鉱ダム決壊事故について、従来の決定論的解析では捉えきれない入力パラメータの不確実性を定量化する確率論的枠組みを提案する。HEC-RASによる決定論的シミュレーション結果を基に、次元削減とメタモデリング（サロゲートモデル）を組み合わせることで、未探索の入力シナリオに対する洪水リスクの高速予測を実現した。さらに、分散ベースの感度分析により、破断水文グラフのパラメータが初期流況を、降伏応力が減衰・拡散領域を支配する物理的メカニズムを明らかにした。本手法は、不確実性を考慮した確率的危険度評価と、入力変数の影響度の解釈を可能にする。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと感度分析による物理現象の高速予測・解析が関心に合致

papers.title: Biologically-Inspired Spike Encoding and Optimization for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer theoretical energy-efficiency advantages over conventional deep networks, but realizing these advantages on vision tasks requires sparse spike representations that naive rate-coding methods fail to provide. We combine biologically motivated spike-encoding schemes with two training improvements: Rouser adaptive-threshold surrogate gradients and Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) second-order optimization. The spike encoding schemes experimented with are rate coding, latency coding, DVS-style delta modulation, and Difference-of-Gaussians (DoG) filtering. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST demonstrate that biologically inspired encoders yield the largest accuracy gains in capacity-constrained regimes and serve as an effective parameter-efficiency lever. DoG and delta modulation encoders produce significantly sparser spike trains than rate coding. K-FAC yields modest but consistent accuracy improvements over Adam-trained baselines, and Rouser's learnable per-neuron thresholds improve Fashion-MNIST accuracy from 87.37% to 88.13% by enabling homeostatic firing-rate regulation. Biologically grounded pre-processing methods can help close the accuracy gap between SNNs and non-spiking baselines without increasing model size.
papers.title_ja: スパイキングニューラルネットワークのための生物学的インスピレーションに基づくスパイク符号化と最適化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、スパイキングニューラルネットワーク（SNN）のエネルギー効率と精度を向上させるための手法を提案する。生物学的に動機づけられたスパイク符号化（レート符号化、遅延符号化、DVS風デルタ変調、DoGフィルタリング）と、Rouser適応閾値サロゲート勾配およびK-FAC二階最適化を組み合わせる。MNISTおよびFashion-MNISTでの実験により、これらの符号化がモデルサイズを増やさずに精度を向上させ、特に容量制約下でパラメータ効率の向上に寄与することが示された。また、DoGやデルタ変調はレート符号化よりもスパイク列を疎にでき、K-FACはAdamベースラインに対して一貫した精度改善をもたらす。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の効率化と最適化手法に関わるが、SNN特化であり軌道力学やLLMとは直接無関係

papers.title: Budgeted Proper Loss Design for Uncertain Decision Thresholds
papers.summary: A binary probability estimate may be used by several decision makers with different error costs. Proper scoring rules can emphasize selected probability thresholds, but a single average threshold distribution need not give a good worst-case regret guarantee. We study the choice of a proper loss when the threshold distribution belongs to a finite specified family. Among integrable loss weights with a positive pointwise floor and a fixed total mass, we derive the weight that minimizes the sharp, distribution-free multiplier from surrogate regret to threshold-averaged decision regret. The solution clips a rescaled upper envelope of the threshold densities at the prescribed floor; its normalization is found by a one-dimensional root search. We give proofs of sharpness, optimality, and stability under density misspecification, as well as a limitation for atomic threshold laws. An exact histogram implementation and two synthetic experiments across 20 seeds verify the construction. The optimized multiplier improves over uniform and average-density weights, while fitted-model performance does not improve uniformly. The result is a loss-design guarantee under an explicit budget, rather than a general claim of predictive superiority.
authors: Ankit Sharma (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore)
papers.title_ja: 不確実な決定閾値に対する予算付きプロパーロス設計
papers.summary_ja: 二値確率推定において、異なる誤差コストを持つ複数の意思決定者に対応するため、閾値分布の有限族に対して最適なプロパーロス（損失関数）を設計する手法を提案する。指定された予算（総質量）と下限値の制約下で、サロゲートレグレットから閾値平均決定レグレットへの乗数を最小化する重み付けを導出する。この重みは閾値密度の上限包絡をスケーリングし、指定された下限でクリップすることで得られ、正規化は一次元の根探索により決定される。シミュレーション実験により、この最適化された乗数が均一重みや平均密度重みよりも性能を向上させることを示し、密度誤指定に対する安定性や鋭さの証明も行う。
papers.relevance_reason: 確率推定と損失関数設計はML基礎だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化との直接関連は薄い。

papers.title: Rented Oscillations: Multi-Tenant Data Center Workload Synchronization Attacks and Mitigation
papers.summary: Multi-tenant data center (DC) facilities rent computing capacity on demand, placing controllable load within reach of anyone willing to pay for it. This paper considers a stealthy adversary who rents workstations and runs deliberately unoptimized large language model (LLM) training, synchronizing their consumption into large periodic oscillations while each workload remains individually indistinguishable from benign training. The periodicity of such workloads is characterized experimentally and used to model facility consumption, showing that oscillations emerge from the interaction of concurrent workloads, whether aligned by an adversary or arising naturally. A combined small- and large-signal assessment, under a hardware-grounded threat model whose feasibility is supported by experiments on a supercomputer, locates the oscillatory weak points of the network. MW-scale oscillations are shown to saturate the generators' control limiters, amplifying their effect, while Floquet analysis reveals a lightly damped mode emerging near the forcing frequency. To counter both origins, signal-energy-based detection and mitigation are proposed, the latter re-timing the workloads to minimize the facility's oscillatory energy. The approach is validated through power hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) experiments and real-time simulations on a surrogate model of the Saudi Arabian transmission network.
papers.title_ja: レンタル振動：マルチテナントデータセンターにおけるワークロード同期攻撃と緩和策
papers.summary_ja: マルチテナントデータセンターで、悪意ある第三者が非最適化されたLLMトレーニングを同期実行し、電力消費に周期的な振動（オシレーション）を生じさせる攻撃手法を提案する。この振動は発電機の制御リミッターを飽和させ、電力網に大きな影響を与える可能性がある。論文では、Floquet解析を用いた脆弱性の特定と、シグナルエネルギーに基づく検出・緩和手法を提案する。サウジアラビア送電網のサロゲートモデルを用いたリアルタイムシミュレーションとPHIL実験により、その有効性を検証している。

papers.title: Faster to the Wrong Answer: The Price of Local Updates in Federated Optimization
papers.summary: Local computation can improve the conditioning of federated updates but may also introduce bias, causing their fixed point to differ from the global minimizer. We characterize the minimum worst-case bias achievable under a prescribed conditioning bound. We consider strongly convex quadratic client objectives with Hessian eigenvalues in $[\mu,L]$ and local updates represented by a shared positive spectral filter. Client heterogeneity is measured by the root-mean-square gradient at the global minimizer. For a uniform surrogate condition number bounded by $\chi\in[1,L/\mu]$, we establish the exact worst-case bias per unit heterogeneity, $(L-\mu\chi)/(2\mu L\sqrt{\chi})$, and show that local gradient descent with sufficiently small step sizes and proximal updates attain this bound. Our analysis reduces populations of arbitrary dimension, including noncommuting Hessians, to distributions over scalar curvatures. This reduction provides optimality certificates and worst-case constructions involving at most three scalar clients. We further extend the sharp proximal bias bound to smooth strongly convex objectives beyond quadratics and quantify the error introduced by inexact local solves.
papers.title_ja: 誤った答えへの高速化：連邦最適化におけるローカル更新の代償
papers.summary_ja: 連邦学習におけるローカル計算は条件数を改善する一方で、バイアスによる最適解のズレを生む可能性がある。本論文は、強凸二次関数と滑らかな強凸関数において、所与の条件数制約下で達成可能な最悪ケースのバイアスの下限を厳密に特徴付け、ローカル勾配降下法や近接更新がその境界に達することを示した。また、非可換ヘッセ行列を持つ任意次元の集団をスカラー曲率の分布に還元する手法を提案し、最適性証明書と最悪ケースの構成を導出した。さらに、不完全なローカル解による誤差の定量化も行った。

papers.title: Diffusion-Score-Based Joint Topology Identification and Generative Particle Filtering
papers.summary: Inferring the interaction graph of a networked system while tracking its latent state is central to infrastructure, environmental, and brain networks. Joint identification of interaction topology and latent network states is challenging when observations are intermittent and transition noise is unknown and non-Gaussian. We develop TopoScore-FAF, a diffusion-score-based framework for joint topology identification and generative particle filtering. The graph governs a leaky-diffusion conditional mean, while a frozen diffusion emulator represents the centered transition residual, avoiding the structural ambiguity of unrestricted generative models. First, we establish a score--topology duality that expresses edge-wise transition likelihood gradients as projections of the residual diffusion score. This enables topology learning without evaluating transition densities or differentiating through the generative sampler. Second, we develop diffusion-score-based topology identification with guarantees of identifiability under intermittent observations and invariance of the population minimizer across diffusion noise levels. Sufficient smoothing yields global strong convexity for bounded-plus-Gaussian residuals. As smoothing vanishes, the asymptotic covariance of the state-pair estimator decreases toward the Cram\'er--Rao bound, with a strict advantage over Gaussian quasi-likelihood under an edge-relevant non-Gaussianity condition. Third, we construct a topology-conditioned generative particle filter that combines guided residual sampling with score-driven graph updates. We establish mean-square closed-loop error bounds under a step-size-independent small-gain condition. The resulting framework uses the graph to structure state propagation and the estimated states to refine the graph. Synthetic and real-data experiments demonstrate its benefits under non-Gaussian forcing.
papers.title_ja: 拡散スコアに基づくトポロジー識別と生成型パーティクルフィルタリングの同時実装
papers.summary_ja: 非ガウスノイズや観測の断続性がある条件下で、ネットワークの相互作用グラフ（トポロジー）と潜在状態を同時に推定するフレームワーク「TopoScore-FAF」を提案する。拡散モデルのスコア関数とトポロジー間の二重性を確立し、遷移密度の評価や生成サンプラーへの微分を回避しながらトポロジーを学習する手法を開発した。さらに、トポロジー条件付きの生成型パーティクルフィルタを構築し、ステップサイズに依存しない小ゲイン条件のもとで平均二乗閉ループ誤差の上限を理論的に保証する。合成データおよび実データ実験により、非ガウス強制力下での有効性を示した。

papers.title: A boundary integral formulation for microscale Marangoni surfing
papers.summary: We consider a model for collections of surfactant-producing particles moving along the surface of a viscous fluid under their self-generated Marangoni flows. Such systems are challenging due to their nonlocal nature: particle motion is coupled to Marangoni stresses distributed across the entire fluid surface and to the resulting flows in the bulk. In the low Reynolds and P\'eclet number limit, we reduce these nonlocal effects to a system of integral equations supported solely on the particles and their boundaries. This formulation is not only computationally tractable, but also provides a framework for systematically coarse-graining many-particle systems. Numerical simulations, performed with a custom spectral method, show collective dynamics are highly sensitive to shape. In particular, among elliptical particles, we find prolate particles tend to attract while oblate particles tend to repel, and these geometric details control the stability of polarized populations. We rationalize these behaviors through a far-field expansion of the boundary integral equations and its corresponding reduced-order model.
papers.title_ja: 微小スケールのマランゴニサーフィンの境界積分表現
papers.summary_ja: 粘性流体表面を自己生成したマランゴニ流で移動する界面活性物質生成粒子の集団動態を扱う。低レイノルズ数・低ペクレ数条件下で、非局所的な効果を粒子境界上の積分方程式系に帰着させることで計算効率を向上させた。この枠組みを用いた数値シミュレーションでは、楕円粒子の形状（長楕円は引力、短楕円は斥力）が極性集団の安定性に大きく影響することが示された。さらに、境界積分方程式の遠場展開に基づく縮約モデルにより、これらの幾何学的依存性を理論的に説明している。

papers.title: Prioritize, Don't Decide: What We Learned Auditing a Deployed Human-in-the-Loop CV Sorter
papers.summary: A single academic vacancy can draw hundreds of applications, and the first screening round consumes most of a committee's time. We describe a CV Priority Sorter deployed at a national platform for academic vacancies and integrated with its vacancy database. It proposes a reading order for a pile of CVs and leaves every decision to the committee, pairing a frozen multilingual transformer encoder with a per-session linear model that retrains after each label and is discarded when the session ends. It works: on a pool of 300 synthetic CVs, a committee reading in the tool's order reaches 95% of the relevant candidates after half the pile, where an arbitrary order needs almost all of it. This paper is about what we found when we audited that claim, rather than about the system itself. Three findings changed the product. The pool turned out to be sortable by document length alone, which makes precision-style metrics on it uninformative; regenerating it under a shared length budget removes that shortcut and leaves the reading-depth result standing. The four-level agreement score such systems report, ours included, is a binary probability cut at fixed thresholds, so it follows the classifier's confidence rather than its ranking and falls as labels accumulate. And uncertainty sampling, the obvious way to implement a "suggest the next CV" button, leaves model quality intact but raises the committee's total reading load above the no-label baseline, because the CVs it asks about are the ones that would otherwise be skipped. A fourth result shows where to look next: a hosted LLM embedding model lifts zero-label ordinal discrimination from 0.66 to 0.80 under length control, then stops mattering once the session model has two dozen labels; a local cross-encoder matches that cold-start gain without sending data out. We report the fixes each finding forced.
papers.title_ja: 優先順位付け、決定しない：デプロイされた人間介入型CVソーター監査から学んだこと
papers.summary_ja: 学術職応募書類のスクリーニング支援ツールとして、凍結したマルチリンガルトランスフォーマーエンコーダーとセッションごとに再学習される線形モデルを組み合わせたCV優先度ソーターの監査結果を報告する。文書長だけでソート可能であることが判明し、従来の精度指標が無意味であることを示した上で、長さ制約下での評価手法を提案した。また、不確実性サンプリングが委員会の総読取負荷を増大させる問題や、LLM埋め込みモデルがコールドスタート時の識別性能を向上させるが、ラベル蓄積後は効果が薄れることを明らかにした。最後に、データ外部送信を避けつつ同等の性能を得るローカルクロスエンコーダーの有効性を示し、実務的な改善策を提示している。

papers.title: RFBench: A Simulator-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark for Passive RF Layout Design and Understanding
papers.summary: While multimodal language models can interpret diagrams and generate structured outputs, their capacity to connect passive radio-frequency (RF) design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce RFBench, a simulator-grounded dataset and benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding. The dataset contains 10,000 two-port planar layouts simulated using ADS Momentum, with each layout represented by editable geometric primitives, a raster image, a 16x16 occupancy grid, complex S-parameters at 201 frequency points, a structural category, and an RF response label. Building on these aligned representations, we define seven tasks spanning specification-conditioned layout generation, representation translation, response prediction, simulator-based validation, design diagnosis and improvement, structural understanding, and response classification. Extensive baselines across seven multimodal language models reveal systematic weaknesses in generating structurally valid layouts and predicting electromagnetically faithful responses. We show that RF-specific fine-tuning increases T1a structural validity from 0.0% to 83.2% and the T3 primitive-input within-2-dB rate from 17.7% to 62.8%, demonstrating the value of domain adaptation while leaving considerable room for further progress. RFBench establishes a common testbed for evaluating multimodal RF capabilities and guiding the development of models that connect design intent and layout representations with physical behavior.
papers.title_ja: RFBench: パッシブRFレイアウト設計と理解のためのシミュレータベースのマルチモーダルベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、パッシブRF回路のレイアウト設計と電磁気特性の理解を評価するためのシミュレータ統合型マルチモーダルベンチマーク「RFBench」を提案する。ADS Momentumでシミュレートした10,000件の2ポート平面レイアウトデータを用い、仕様条件付きレイアウト生成や応答予測など7つのタスクを定義した。7つのマルチモーダルLLMによる評価では、構造的に有効なレイアウト生成や電磁気的に忠実な応答予測において系統的な弱点が明らかになった。RF特化ファインチューニングにより構造有効性が0.0%から83.2%へ向上し、ドメイン適応の価値を示したが、依然として改善の余地がある。

papers.title: Finetuning VLAs for Dexterous Manipulation: The Right Checkpoint Is All You Need
papers.summary: Vision-Language-Action models have demonstrated strong manipulation capabilities. A limitation of VLA models is that most manipulation datasets focus on parallel-jaw gripper systems, making transfer to multi-finger hands challenging, particularly as teleoperation datasets are harder to collect with multi-fingered robots. In this work, we study how to best adapt VLAs to dexterous hands by pairing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with diffusion-steering reinforcement learning (DSRL). Using $\pi_{0.5}$ and a LEAP hand, we evaluate five fine-tuning recipes across two simulation tasks using only a handful of demonstrations. Our empirical analysis yields three key insights: (1) SFT success is poorly correlated with post-DSRL success, meaning the best SFT checkpoint is rarely the most effective to steer; (2) freezing the vision-language model (VLM) and tuning only the action expert produces the most steerable policy for both training and out-of-distribution placements; and (3) low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is the least steerable approach. Consequently, we recommend an adaptation recipe that freezes the VLM, fully trains the action expert, and eschews SFT rollout success as a checkpoint selection metric.
papers.title_ja: 器用な操作のためのVLAファインチューニング：適切なチェックポイントがすべてである
papers.summary_ja: 視覚言語行動モデル（VLA）を多指ハンドへの適用において、教師ありファインチューニング（SFT）と拡散誘導強化学習（DSRL）の組み合わせ手法を提案する。実験により、SFT時の成功度はDSRL後の性能と相関が低く、VLMを凍結しアクションエキスパートのみを訓練する方が適応性が高いことが判明した。また、LoRAは適応性が最も低く、チェックポイント選択にはSFTのロールアウト成功度を指標とすべきではないと結論づけている。

papers.title: Localizing Text Anonymization for Trustworthy AI: Extending RAT-Bench to Malaysian Microdata and PII
papers.summary: As governments and organizations adopt foundation models for public services and workplace productivity, sensitive citizen, employee, and administrative text may enter LLM workflows through inference, retrieval, fine-tuning, or local model development. We examine whether text anonymizers transfer to new deployment settings by extending RAT-Bench to Malaysia using local microdata, Malaysian PII formats, and culturally grounded transcripts in Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia. We evaluate NER- and LLM-based anonymizers using an LLM attacker that infers attributes from anonymized text, measuring both re-identification success and text utility. Across Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia, the two LLM anonymizers provide the strongest explicit privacy-utility trade-offs, reducing Easy/Hard re-identification risk to 23-29% while preserving BLEU scores of 0.77-0.94. Non-LLM tools show sharper failure modes, either preserving utility while leaving high residual risk or reducing risk through severe over-redaction, especially in Bahasa Malaysia. These findings suggest that anonymizers should be evaluated against deployment-relevant languages, identifier formats, and cultural contexts before being relied on in public-sector, workplace, or local AI pipelines.
papers.title_ja: 信頼できるAIのためのテキスト匿名化のローカライズ：マレーシアのマイクロデータとPIIへのRAT-Benchの拡張
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、マレーシアのローカルデータとPII形式を用いてRAT-Benchを拡張し、テキスト匿名化ツールの汎用性を評価した。NERベースとLLMベースの匿名化ツールを比較し、LLMアタッカーによる再識別リスクとテキスト有用性を測定した。結果、LLMベースのツールがプライバシーと有用性のバランスを最もよく保ち、再識別リスクを23-29%に抑えつつBLEUスコア0.77-0.94を維持した。非LLMツールは過剰な削除による有用性低下や、リスク残留という明確な失敗モードを示した。

papers.title: Neural Network-Based Modeling of Hysteretic Systems: From Prandtl and Preisach Neural Networks to Neuro-Madelung and Neuroplastic Continuous Models
papers.summary: Hysteresis is a complex nonlinear phenomenon characterized by memory dependence, path dependence, and, in many physical systems, degradation, non-congruency, asymmetry, and rate dependence. This review examines the development and capabilities of Prandtl neural networks (PNNs), Preisach neural networks (PreisachNNs), generalized Prandtl neural networks (GPNNs), the neuro-Madelung model (NMM), extended Preisach neural networks (EPNNs), and dynamic plastic continuous neural networks (DPCNNs). Particular attention is given to their mechanisms for representing memory, network architectures, activation functions, training algorithms, treatment of deterioration and rate dependence, and applications to nonlinear structural and material systems. The PNN introduced hysteretic memory directly into neural activation through stop operators and demonstrated accurate nonlinear dynamic analysis of structures. Preisach-NNs subsequently extended this concept through an additional nonlinear hidden layer to represent non-Masing hysteresis. GPNNs introduced deteriorating-stop neurons to capture stiffness and strength degradation and non-congruent hysteresis. A different generalization was provided by the NMM, which combined Madelung's hysteresis rules with multilayer feedforward neural networks to represent diverse rate-independent and rate-dependent behaviors. These developments culminated in the EPNN, which combines deteriorating hysteretic operators, nonlinear neural mappings, and input-rate information to accommodate Masing and nonMasing, symmetric and asymmetric, congruent and noncongruent, and rate-independent and rate-dependent hysteresis.
papers.title_ja: ヒステリシス系のニューラルネットワークによるモデリング：Prandtl・PreisachニューラルネットワークからNeuro-MadelungおよびNeuroplastic連続モデルへ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ヒステリシス現象を表現するPrandtlニューラルネットワーク（PNN）やPreisachニューラルネットワーク（PreisachNN）などの発展をレビューする。これらのモデルは、停止演算子や非線形隠れ層を用いて記憶依存性や経路依存性を捉え、構造力学や材料システムにおける非線形動的解析に適用される。さらに、劣化や速度依存性を考慮した汎化モデルとして、Neuro-Madelungモデルや拡張Preisachニューラルネットワーク（EPNN）が提案されている。これらは、対称・非対称、同型・非同型、速度非依存・速度依存の多様なヒステリシス挙動を統一的に記述する能力を持つ。

papers.title: Response-Relevant Information Is Not Sufficient for Neural Training-State Equivalence
papers.summary: Response-relevant information is not sufficient evidence that two neural networks are in the same training state. We define training-state equivalence operationally: two checkpoints are equivalent, relative to an intervention family and horizon, if they respond alike when training is perturbed and continues. On fresh runs of a one-layer transformer learning modular addition, response to a weight-decay pulse is highly reproducible relative to between-checkpoint differences (rho_state = 0.934 at 500 steps), establishing the target as measurable. Fifteen descriptors of weight spectra, representation geometry and optimiser geometry carry within-run response-relevant information beyond weight norm and loss on a development dataset, predicting held-out response deviation across seed blocks. But their apparent 16.1% advantage at matching checkpoints by future response does not separate from a conditional placebo preserving each descriptor's fitted dependence on the conventional observables, and a calibrated positive control makes simple insensitivity an unlikely explanation. Information a decoder can extract need not be organised in the pairwise geometry that similarity judgments require.
papers.title_ja: 応答関連情報はニューラルネットワークの学習状態の等価性を保証しない
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、ニューラルネットワークの学習状態の等価性を、訓練を中断・介入した後の応答の再現性として操作的に定義し、1層トランスフォーマーを用いて検証した。重みスペクトルや表現幾何学などの記述子は、損失や重みノルム以上の情報を持ち、将来の応答偏差を予測できるが、その優位性は従来の観測量への依存性を保持するプラセボ効果と区別できないことが判明した。つまり、デコーダーが抽出可能な情報と、類似度判断に必要なペアワイズ幾何学的構造は必ずしも一致しないことを示唆している。

papers.title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions for Certified Reachability of Learning-Enabled Systems
papers.summary: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one polynomial must stay accurate across that set, and it reaches only as far as its disc of convergence. The limit binds hardest on the rational terms and sigmoid gates of modern controllers: smooth as these look on the real line, in the complex plane they blow up at points just off the real axis, closer as a gate sharpens, and those points cap the set width a Taylor expansion can cover, most tightly on the switching surface where the controller decides. We prove a dichotomy: no Taylor degree certifies sets wider than that cap, while a Chebyshev abstraction of equal degree, anchored to the whole set in the same polynomial-zonotope pipeline, has no cap and gains width at a geometric rate in degree. Measured walls match the formulas to between 89 and 94 percent. We give closed-form rigorous remainders, among them the first polynomial softmax transformer; existing sound treatments are linear relaxations. On closed loops, certificates survive where the Taylor ones diverge, and specifications flip from unknown to proven; on trained classifiers up to real MNIST digits, the Chebyshev frontier certifies input territory the Taylor basis surrenders. Every certified claim passed large Monte-Carlo harnesses with zero violations, and an applicability map states in advance where the basis provably cannot matter.
papers.title_ja: 学習ベースシステムの認証済みリーチアビリティのためのチェビシェフ多項体抽象化
papers.summary_ja: 非線形ダイナミクスのリーチアビリティ解析において、従来のテイラー展開が収束半径に制約される問題を指摘し、チェビシェフ多項体を用いた新しい抽象化手法を提案する。この手法は、シグモイドやソフトマックスなどの非線形関数を含む制御系や分類器において、テイラー展開では証明できない広い入力領域に対して厳密な保証を提供できることを示す。MNISTなどの実データを用いた実験では、テイラーベースでは不確定だった仕様を証明可能にし、モンテカルロ検証でも違反ゼロを確認した。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Universal Differential Equations for Epidemic Dynamics
papers.summary: Universal differential equations (UDEs) combine mechanistic epidemic models with learned neural closures, but generic additive corrections may violate essential epidemiological properties. We introduce a class of structure-preserving epidemic UDEs in which learned closures parameterize intercompartmental fluxes and the force of infection factorizes through infected compartments. This architecture guarantees positivity, population boundedness, and invariance of the disease-free set. We derive a rank-one next-generation matrix and a closed-form basic reproduction number determined by the learned rates at the disease-free equilibrium. Under explicit conditions, we establish results on threshold dynamics, disease-free and endemic equilibria, stability, and uniform persistence. For a neural SEIR model, center manifold analysis characterizes the direction of bifurcation through derivatives of the learned transmission rate. We further establish fundamental identifiability limitations: closures that agree on observed epidemic trajectories can yield different reproduction numbers and bifurcation types. Quantitative bounds relate uncertainty in the reproduction number to closure regularity and the distance of observations from the disease-free equilibrium, while monotonicity provides one-sided bounds. A numerical example involving three closures illustrates these results. Our findings provide a rigorous framework for epidemiologically consistent scientific machine learning and clarify which dynamical properties can be recovered from epidemic data.
papers.title_ja: 疫学動態における構造保存型汎用微分方程式
papers.summary_ja: 機械学習と疫学モデルを統合する汎用微分方程式（UDE）において、学習された補正項が疫学的性質（正性・有界性など）を破綻させる問題を解決するため、構造保存型アーキテクチャを提案する。感染区画間のフラックスをパラメータ化し、感染力の因子分解を通じて、疾病自由集合の不変性を保証する。さらに、基本再生産数の閉形式導出や分岐解析、同定可能性の限界に関する理論的枠組みを確立し、疫学的一貫性を保った科学的機械学習の基盤を提供する。

papers.title: Confidence-Based Materials Data Quality Assessment via Domain Knowledge and Graph-Structured Learning
papers.summary: The rapid development of materials machine learning relies on large-scale, heterogeneous datasets, yet model reliability is often compromised by imperfect data from diverse experiments, simulations, and database integration. Real-world materials databases may contain measurement errors, failed calculations, missing or duplicate records, and hidden violations of physicochemical constraints. Such problems are difficult to identify because corrupted samples may remain statistically plausible rather than appearing as explicit outliers. In this paper, we propose a confidence-based materials data quality assessment framework that integrates domain knowledge with graph-structured learning. Data quality is formulated as a continuous confidence estimation problem rather than a binary anomaly identification task, enabling sample-level assessment and historical-reference-based batch comparison. A nine-dimensional feature-quality prior and duplicate-aware sample initialization are calibrated using materials domain rules and statistical evidence. Confidence is further refined through sample-feature bipartite graph propagation and weakly supervised graph attention, while a Memory-GAT module provides historical reference scoring. Experiments on 23 ODDS benchmark datasets show that the generic module achieves an average AUC-ROC of 0.866. In five repeated mixed-contamination experiments on mp\_20, rule calibration improves HistGradientBoostingRegressor test $R^2$ from $0.538\pm0.008$ to $0.616\pm0.014$. Graph refinement increases average precision from $0.943\pm0.004$ to 0.953\pm0.004$, while the rule-calibrated configuration has the highest mean test $R^2$ among the evaluated screening configurations. Five repeated MACE subset experiments further show an increase in $R^2$ from $0.590\pm0.053$ to $0.880\pm0.027$ after rule-based screening.
papers.title_ja: ドメイン知識とグラフ構造学習を用いた信頼度ベースの材料データ品質評価
papers.summary_ja: 材料科学における機械学習モデルの信頼性を高めるため、ドメイン知識とグラフ構造学習を統合したデータ品質評価フレームワークを提案する。異常検知を二値判定ではなく連続的な信頼度推定として定式化し、サンプル単位の評価と履歴参照による比較を可能にする。9次元の特徴量品質事前分布と重複認識サンプル初期化を用いてルールを較正し、サンプル-特徴量二部グラフ伝播や弱教師ありグラフアテンション、Memory-GATモジュールにより信頼度を精緻化する。23個のODDSベンチマークデータセットでの実験で平均AUC-ROC 0.866を達成し、ルール較正とグラフ洗練により下流タスクの予測精度（R^2やAP）が向上することを示した。

papers.title: Incremental Roseland: Batch-wise Landmark Diffusion via Kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Lo\`eve Update
papers.summary: Landmark diffusion (Roseland) computes a diffusion-map-style spectral embedding from the singular value decomposition of a degree-normalized data-to-landmark kernel matrix, at a cost far below that of full diffusion maps. It assumes, however, that all data are available at once. We introduce incremental Roseland (iRoseland), which casts the landmark affinity as a row-growing matrix whose SVD can be updated with a kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Lo\`eve (SKL) scheme. Degre correction is handled by a first order expansion about a reference mean kernel row and so that the landmark-side eigenbasis may be recovered from a single landmark-by-landmark eigendecomposition at each step. The presented method requires only a single pass over the data and runs in bounded-memory with state independent of the number of points processed. A forgetting factor lets the method track drifting distributions, and a sample-size-invariant embedding keeps outputs comparable across time. Experiments show agreement with Roseland to round-off on stationary data, and accuracy that exceeds equal-memory Roseland by an order of magnitude on long streams. On drifting data, we observe large gains from forgetting with a window matched to the drift.

papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ランドマーク拡散（Roseland）を逐次処理可能な形式に拡張した「増分型Roseland（iRoseland）」を提案する。カーネル化逐次Karhunen-Loève（SKL）手法を用いてSVDを効率的に更新し、メモリ使用量を有界に保ちながらデータストリームを単一パスで処理できる。忘却係数により分布ドリフトへの追従が可能であり、サンプルサイズ不変な埋め込みにより時間軸での比較性を確保する。実験では、定常データでは既存手法と同等の精度を示し、長期間のストリームでは同等メモリ条件下で1桁高い精度を実現した。

papers.title: Adaptive Line Switching for Cascade Mitigation in Power Systems via Graph Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Although cascading failures are relatively rare events in power systems, they pose significant risks and can lead to severe economic and societal consequences within a short period. Therefore, developing effective mitigation strategies to prevent cascade propagation and to minimize their impacts is essential. This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based framework for adaptive transmission line switching to mitigate cascading failures. Given the important role of network topology and component interactions in cascading failure propagation in power systems, graph-based DRL approaches, including Graph-DQN, Graph-A2C, and Graph-PPO frameworks, are developed to capture and utilize the topological information of power systems. The proposed frameworks are evaluated on the IEEE 39, 57, and 118 bus systems and benchmarked against the unmitigated case, random and heuristic-based switching strategies as baselines, as well as their corresponding graph-agnostic DRL counterparts. The results demonstrate the importance of incorporating graph information into these mitigation frameworks, leading to reduced cascade size, load loss, and network clustering.
papers.title_ja: グラフ強化学習を用いた電力システムにおけるカスケード障害緩和のための適応的系統切替
papers.summary_ja: 電力システムにおけるカスケード障害の緩和を目的とし、グラフ強化学習（Graph-DQN, Graph-A2C, Graph-PPO）を用いた送電線切替の最適化フレームワークを提案する。電力網のトポロジー情報を活用することで、従来のグラフ非依存型DRLやヒューリスティック手法よりも効果的に障害の伝播を抑制できることを示した。IEEE 39, 57, 118バスシステムでの評価により、負荷損失やネットワーククラスタリングの低減効果が確認された。

papers.title: Stability Does Not Mirror Plasticity: A Module-Level View of Declarative and Procedural Learning in Transformers
papers.summary: Plasticity and stability in continual learning are typically studied at the entire-model level and in a task-agnostic manner, yet prior work has reported divergent conclusions across settings. Inspired by cognitive distinctions between declarative and procedural memory, we instead study how plasticity and stability vary across transformer modules and task types. In a controlled synthetic environment with clean measurement, we show a double dissociation: query-key (QK) and value-output (VO) projections are the most plastic on procedural tasks, whereas MLPs are the most plastic on declarative memorization. Stability, however, does not simply mirror plasticity: when learning a new procedure, updating QK retains over half of the stored declarative memory, while updating MLPs retains far less and updating VO loses roughly four-fifths. Targeted module reset-and-recovery experiments explain this asymmetry: plasticity tracks which module is best suited to a task's primary computation or storage, whereas stability depends on all ways the existing capability relies on that module, including access to information stored in other modules. Experiments on a realistic model and tasks broadly echo these asymmetric dynamics. Overall, our work shows that plasticity and stability depend on different aspects of a module's functional role, offering a task-dependent, module-level perspective on continual learning.
papers.title_ja: 安定性は可塑性を反映しない：トランスフォーマーにおける宣言的・手続き的学習のモジュールレベル視点
papers.summary_ja: トランスフォーマーの継続学習において、安定性と可塑性がモデル全体ではなくモジュール単位で異なることを示した。手続き的タスクではQK/VO射影、宣言的記憶ではMLPが最も可塑性を持つという二重解離を特定した。しかし安定性は可塑性と一致せず、QK更新は宣言的記憶を保持する一方、MLP更新は大幅に喪失する非対称性を解明した。これはモジュールの機能役割と既存能力への依存関係が安定性を決定づけることを示唆する。

papers.title: A Graph-Theoretic Framework for Identifying Mathematical Programming Decompositions
papers.summary: We develop a framework for identifying combinations of complicating variables and/or constraints that can be used to formulate mathematical programming decompositions. A mathematical program is represented by a graph which accounts for the structural and functional relationship between variables and constraints. Graph projections are used to focus on variable- or constraint-based decompositions. A series of coarsening operations is used to generate a reduced graph based on the original or projected graph. On the reduced graph, we use integer programming to identify different combinations of complicating variables and/or constraints. Specifically, variables and constraints are identified as complicating based on their structural role and/or their functionality (contribution to nonlinearity) in the mathematical program. The framework allows us to assess the viability of different decomposition types (variable, constraint, cross) and identify multiple potential decomposition formulations of the same type (e.g. different combinations of complicating variables for Benders decomposition). The systematic nature of our framework facilitates broader studies into the efficacy of different decompositions across a range of problems including energy markets, process design, and machine learning.

papers.title: AllotNet: an Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts Choice Model for Moral Judgement in Humanitarian Aid Allocation, Validated against a Planted Synthetic Population
papers.summary: Official development assistance fell by 23.1 per cent in 2025, and the decision of who is helped first when there is not enough for everyone is moving into software. A leading published machine-learning targeting system excluded 53 per cent of eligible households as deployed. If the rule of distribution ends up in code, it should carry the judgement of many cultures, and the machine should execute while a person judges. AllotNet is an interpretable mixture-of-experts conditional logit for the allocation judgements elicited by Allot, a pre-registered six-language instrument: eight linear taste experts over seven ethical criteria, weighted by a gate over participant context, with a damped residual, an encoder for household intake, an outcome head and a budget-constrained planner that builds a review queue and never rejects anyone. A model of human judgement has no answer key on real data, so we wrote one first: a planted synthetic population of 5.6 million sessions and 104 million responses (98 million usable choices), generated by the production code path from a ground truth hidden from the loss. All sixteen pre-specified checks passed: criterion ranking $\rho = 1.000$, hidden segments recovered (ARI 0.671), outcome head at 99 per cent of the noise ceiling, planner at 99.4 per cent of oracle. The caveats are reported with them: two checks are weaker than their titles, and a live-generation failure cost 260,712 seeds. The model has 23,550 parameters, is trained quantisation-aware for NVFP4 with its interpretable core in fp32 (welfare-rank parity $\rho = 0.9937$ at W4A16 on the shipped bundle; one parity threshold was relaxed post hoc), and ships as a 125 KB bundle with C11, Java, Rust and Python runtimes. Nothing has been trained on real data yet; at the study's real scale a hierarchical Bayesian mixed logit is the registered comparator.
papers.title_ja: AllotNet: 人道支援配分における道徳的判断のための解釈可能なMixture-of-Experts選択モデル（合成人口による検証）
papers.summary_ja: 人道支援の配分判断を支援する、解釈可能なMixture-of-Experts（MoE）ベースの条件付きロジットモデル「AllotNet」を提案する。6言語で収集した判断データを用い、倫理基準に基づく8つの線形エキスパートとコンテキストゲートで構成し、予算制約付きプランナーを実装した。実データに正解がないため、560万セッションの合成人口を生成し、事前指定された16項目の検証で高い再現性（基準ランキングρ=1.000等）を確認した。さらに、NVFP4量子化対応で125KBの軽量バンドルとして提供し、実務での高速推論と解釈可能性を両立させている。

papers.title: Optimal Control of RKHS Diffeomorphic Flows for Classification and Generative Modeling
papers.summary: We develop a unified optimal-control framework that solves supervised classification and likelihood-based density estimation with a single diffeomorphic flow whose velocity lives in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS); the two tasks share all structure except the objective. Variable projection eliminates the terminal model (a classifier, or a Gaussian-mixture (GMM) reference), leaving a reduced control problem whose gradient comes from an analytic discrete adjoint. The RKHS parameterization makes the flow's divergence exact and deterministic at the cost of one kernel matrix-vector product, avoiding the stochastic trace estimators and potential-flow restrictions of existing continuous normalizing flows. Because the objective and gradient are deterministic, matrix-free reduced Gauss-Newton (GN) and related second-order solvers are practical for both tasks, which we benchmark against a range of first- and second-order optimizers; the learned map is a diffeomorphism with explicitly controlled regularity. In experiments from dimension 2 to 256, the reduced GN solvers use the fewest iterations of any optimizer tested and, together with joint L-BFGS, the least work; a multiscale kernel improves the density fit, and a trainable GMM reference reduces the deformation needed for multimodal transport at comparable likelihood while lowering the likelihood on real data. The full-model solve is quadratic in the particle count and sub-linear in dimension; a control-point reduction makes the particle-count scaling linear at near-lossless accuracy.
papers.title_ja: 分類と生成モデリングのためのRKHS微分同相フローの最適制御
papers.summary_ja: 再生核ヒルベルト空間（RKHS）上で定義される微分同相フローを用い、分類と密度推定を統一的な最適制御問題として定式化する手法を提案する。変数射影により終端モデルを消去し、解析的な離散共役変数から勾配を導出することで、確定的な勾配計算を実現した。これにより、行列フリーな縮約ガウス・ニュートン法などの2階最適化手法が実用的となり、既存の連続正規化フローにおける確率的トレース推定やポテンシャルフローの制約を回避する。実験では、2次元から256次元までで最速の収束速度を示し、粒子数に対する計算コストを線形に削減する手法も検証されている。

papers.title: Goemans's Unsplittable-Flow Conjecture: The Anatomy of AI-Assisted Counterexample Discovery
papers.summary: Goemans conjectured that any fractional single-source flow could be converted into an unsplittable flow without increasing total cost and while increasing any arc load by at most the largest demand. Recently, Dmitry Rybin announced a seven-vertex counterexample found through an interaction with ChatGPT, which disproved this long-standing conjecture. However, the interaction did not reveal why this particular topology and its demand, fractional-flow, and cost choices work together, whether the example belongs to a broader family, or which structural features determine where counterexamples can occur. It also left unclear why the AI-assisted search succeeded where earlier human efforts had not. In this paper, we develop a forward counterexample construction pipeline. It starts from an arborescence on which failure is impossible and adds terminal-entering shortcut arcs. The resulting load constraints define a finite set of admissible route choices; their convex hull, the conflict polytope, yields exact conditions for demands, fractional flows, and costs. Starting from a simple arborescence, the pipeline selects Rybin's topology and characterizes all counterexamples it supports. Experiments further demonstrate the pipeline's transferability: when instructed to follow it while varying the initial arborescence and shortcut placement, ChatGPT produced counterexamples on topologies genuinely different from Rybin's and found valid constructions starting from 93 other rooted arborescence shapes. The theory also explains why the original example was difficult to discover through blind enumeration and suggests that Rybin's interaction lies between blind enumeration and a complete theory-guided construction.
papers.title_ja: Goemans の非分割フロー予想：AI 支援による反例発見の解剖
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ChatGPT との対話を通じて発見された Goemans の非分割フロー予想の反例を、理論的に分析・再現するパイプラインを提案する。木構造から始まる初期状態にショートカット弧を追加し、許容される経路選択の凸包（競合多面体）を導出することで、反例が存在するための厳密な条件を特定する。この手法を用いることで、Rybin の反例が属するより広いクラスを特徴付け、なぜ従来のブラインド列挙では発見が難しかったかを説明する。さらに、このパイプラインに従って ChatGPT に操作させると、93 個の異なる木構造から有効な反例を生成できることを実験的に示し、AI 支援探索の成功要因を理論的に裏付けている。

papers.title: From Arraignment to Resolution: Transformer Models of Court Cases
papers.summary: The criminal legal system is composed of many complex decision points, such as which charges are pursued, how bond is determined, plea deal negotiations, and sentencing. Given the profound impact of such decisions, there is a growing need to increase the transparency within this system. While prior machine learning approaches have focused on modeling single decisions (e.g., recidivism), this paper proposes a transformer-based time series model to forecast the outcome of the next proceeding in a case (e.g., charges accepted, bond set, plea deal made, etc.). By modeling a case as an event sequence, we enable a more nuanced analysis to support better oversight and understanding of decision making. We conduct an empirical analysis of thousands of cases using a newly constructed dataset derived from publicly available court records of a mid-sized U.S. city. We fit models that combine textual data from clerk notes with structured information about the defendant, prior charges, and courtroom. Our transformer model achieves $.57$ micro-F1 on a 20-class multi-label task, a significant improvement over several baselines and comparable to a GRU trained on the same input. We demonstrate how the model can be used to provide insights into decision-making and help court observers identify emerging issues within the jurisdiction studied.
papers.title_ja: 起訴から解決まで：裁判事件のTransformerモデル

papers.title: Hierarchical Traffic Engineering for Scalable Software-Defined Satellite Networks
papers.summary: Future satellite systems are shifting toward regenerative payloads that interconnect many modem banks into a reconfigurable on-board network. However, conventional constellation-level routing overlooks intra-payload congestion and load imbalance, which can limit the traffic each satellite can accommodate. This paper proposes a hierarchical software-defined networking (SDN)framework for traffic engineering (TE) across both the constellation and payload levels. The system is represented by a two-level graph, where each satellite node in the constellation graph is expanded into an internal network of interconnected modem banks. The proposed hierarchical payload-aware allocation (HPAA) algorithm coordinates the two levels through the exchange of assigned traffic demand and advertised capacity budgets. Simulation results show that, under heavy load, HPAA delivers about 9 times the throughput of shortest-path routing, with 17% lower end-to-end delay and no packet loss. These findings highlight that hierarchical control accounting for the on-board network constraints of regenerative payloads is a key lever to improve the performance of satellite constellations.
papers.title_ja: スケーラブルなソフトウェア定義衛星ネットワークのための階層型トラフィックエンジニアリング

papers.title: BiMa-ECGSR: reconstructing the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with bidirectional state-space models
papers.summary: Wearables and monitors record few electrocardiogram (ECG) leads; most diagnostic tools assume 12 leads. BiMa-ECGSR reconstructs the 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets with a bidirectional Mamba state-space encoder--decoder, as regression (BiMa-SR) or diffusion (DiBiMa-SR). Models were trained on PTB-XL for six input sets (I; II; I+II; I+II+V1; I+II+V2; I+II+V1+V4), see only the measured leads at inference, and were tested on the PTB-XL test fold (2,198 records) and two external cohorts (Georgia, 10,275 records; Chapman-Shaoxing/Ningbo, 43,559). From lead II alone, the pooled median Pearson correlation (PCC) over the 11 predicted leads was 0.914 on PTB-XL, against 0.784 for a least-squares linear filter (lead I: 0.906 against 0.789). As limb leads are exactly derivable from I and II, multi-lead inputs were compared on predicted chest leads: 0.939 against 0.849 for I+II and 0.979 against 0.962 for I+II+V1+V4. BiMa-SR exceeded the linear comparator in all 18 configuration--cohort pairs (by 0.012--0.136), a margin that shrank as chest leads were added. From lead II, regression was more accurate than diffusion (DiBiMa-SR: 0.903 one-step, 0.862 with six DDIM steps). A 12-lead classifier trained only on real ECGs reached a superclass macro AUROC of 0.912 on real PTB-XL ECGs, 0.843 on reconstructions from lead II and 0.908 from I+II+V1+V4; externally, reconstructions from three or four leads scored within 0.004 of real ECGs. BiMa-SR (2.68\,M parameters) takes 45.8 ms per 10-s record on a GPU. Reconstruction makes reduced-lead recordings usable by 12-lead tools; it cannot add information absent from the measured leads.

papers.title: HardwareDx: A Foundational Graph Model System for Datacenter Machine Repairs
papers.summary: The rapid scale-up of AI infrastructure has made datacenter reliability a cornerstone of the cloud business economy. Since hardware failures in hyper-scale AI clusters can stall multi-million dollar training workloads, the downtime of individual machines can cause outsized economic losses. Minimizing machine downtime, therefore, is more important than ever. To address this, we present Hardware Diagnoser (HardwareDx), an AI-driven hardware diagnosis system that applies a graph foundation model approach to automated datacenter maintenance. It allows a single model to diagnose many platforms and accelerate onboarding of new hardware products. Deployed at production scale at Google, HardwareDx yields substantial efficiency gains across diverse compute architectures. Real-world evaluations demonstrate that it reduces production downtime by 18.3% on GPU platforms and 16.1% on TPUs. Furthermore, it significantly accelerates hardware deployment, cutting quality assurance (QA) time by 28.3% for GPUs and 25.1% for TPUs. papers.title: Rigidity of randomly perturbed expanding circle maps
papers.summary: We extend the classical smooth linearization theory of expanding circle maps to randomly perturbed ones without requiring small perturbations, establishing two equivalent rigidity criteria of absolute continuity of random conjugacy and Lyapunov exponents along random periodic orbits. In the random setting, an essential difficulty is the uniqueness of absolutely continuous random invariant measures. For the first criterion, we overcome this difficulty by refining the memory-loss argument of Ott, Stenlund and Young, which gives the exponential convergence of probability densities, to establish the uniqueness of random invariant measures; for the second criterion, we bypass this difficulty by employing periodic-orbital averaging together with Jensen's equality condition to derive pointwise rigidity directly from the periodic data.
papers.title_ja: ランダム摂動された拡大円写像の剛性
papers.summary_ja: 拡大円写像の古典的な滑らかな線形化理論を、小さな摂動を仮定しないランダム摂動系に拡張した。ランダム共役の絶対連続性とランダム周期軌道に沿ったリアプノフ指数の2つの等価な剛性基準を確立した。ランダム不変測度の一意性の難題に対し、Ottらの記憶喪失論理を洗練させて確率密度の指数収束を示すことで克服した。また、周期軌道の平均化とJensenの等号条件を用いることで、周期データから直接点ごとの剛性を導出する手法も提案した。

papers.title: Gutzwiller Quantum-Classical Embedding for Dynamics Simulations of Correlated Electron Systems
papers.summary: Simulating the real-time dynamics of correlated electron systems requires a nonperturbative treatment of local correlations over long times, a challenge for classical methods. We present the time-dependent Gutzwiller quantum-classical embedding framework, t-GQCE, for generic multi-orbital lattice models with time-dependent Hamiltonians. Within the time-dependent ghost Gutzwiller approximation, the lattice dynamics is mapped onto a noninteracting quasiparticle lattice, propagated classically, coupled to finite interacting embedding models propagated on quantum processors. The two parts exchange only embedding Hamiltonian parameters and single-particle density matrices, and the framework is agnostic to the quantum dynamics solver. We demonstrate it with adaptive variational quantum dynamics simulations of interaction quenches in the Hubbard model on the Bethe lattice. Without ghost orbitals, the embedding problem reduces to a single qubit, simulated on IBM quantum hardware with two qubits, including an ancilla. With more ghost orbitals, t-GQCE suppresses the artificial undamped oscillations of the conventional Gutzwiller approximation and approaches nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory results for weak and strong quenches. Statevector simulations with 2, 4 and 6 ghost orbitals per spin, or 8, 12 and 16 qubits, give adaptive circuits that follow the embedding states with infidelities below $5\times10^{-4}$. Under trapped-ion noise models, circuit compression, measurements in rotated orbital bases with post-selection, and noise mitigation reduce the measurement errors severalfold. At one third of the error rates of a hardware-benchmarked noise model, they reach an accuracy of $0.01$ for the single-particle density matrix and the double occupancy with $10^5$ shots per time step, and the Quantinuum H2-Emulator gives similar accuracy.
papers.title_ja: 相関電子系のダイナミクスシミュレーションのためのGutzwiller量子-古典埋め込み
papers.summary_ja: 相関電子系のリアルタイムダイナミクスを扱うための時間依存Gutzwiller量子-古典埋め込み（t-GQCE）フレームワークを提案する。格子ダイナミクスを非相互作用準粒子格子として古典的に伝搬させ、相互作用する埋め込みモデルを量子プロセッサ上で伝搬させることで、長時間の非摂動局所相関を効率的に扱う。Hubbardモデルの相互作用クエンチにおいて、従来のGutzwiller近似の人工的な減衰しない振動を抑制し、非平衡動的平均場理論の結果に近づけることを示した。IBM量子ハードウェアやQuantinuum H2-Emulatorを用いた実証では、ノイズ低減技術により高精度な密度行列と二重占有数の計算を実現した。

papers.title: Exploring Parkinson's Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Techniques
papers.summary: In recent years, machine learning (ML) techniques have emerged as promising tools for accurate and timely diagnosis of Parkinson's disease (PD) which is an incurable neurodegenerative disorder. This study explores the integration of ML algorithms and PD diagnosis, highlighting their potential applications in various aspects of the disease. ML methods such as support vector machines, decision trees, multilayer perceptron, k-nearest neighbours, logistic regression and random forest (with and without particle swarm optimisation) were applied on a PD dataset obtained from Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust containing data from 58 people. In terms of accuracy, the Decision Tree and Logistic Regression performed the best with scores of 72-76% while multilayer perceptron was least effective. All the models were remarkable in classifying positive PD cases with sensitivity scores going up to 97.56%, with SVM classifier at the pinnacle. However, ability to classify healthy controls from PD cases was insignificant throughout the board. Although, all the employed models delivered reasonable results in categorising PD patients in the presented dataset; access to more data, further study and advancement of these ML approaches could lead to enhanced diagnostic outcomes, supplementing to an improved understanding of Parkinson's disease.
papers.title_ja: 機械学習手法を用いたパーキンソン病診断の探索

papers.title: Subsequent Dust-Fading Events of the Wolf-Rayet Star WR 59: A Continuous Visual Record
papers.summary: This paper presents long-term visual and space-based monitoring of the WC9d Wolf-Rayet star WR 59 from 2017 to 2026, documenting a profound physical transition from a stable baseline to an ongoing phase of continuous dust production. Visual observations using a 22-inch telescope initially established a four-year quiescent baseline at magnitude 13.9. Following the historic May 2021 discovery fade to magnitude 15.2, long-term nightly visual monitoring documented an accelerating sequence of twelve distinct fading episodes over subsequent years, characterised by progressively shorter inter-fade recovery intervals. Due to severe pixel crowding and flux contamination from a close 11.7 V companion star 11 arcseconds away, automated large-pixel survey pipelines remain completely blind to these high-amplitude fading events. Direct comparisons with NASA's TESS satellite photometry during quiet phases show that targeted visual magnitude estimates measure systemic baseline micro-variations with professional accuracy while bridging space mission coverage gaps. High-density observation blocks during the minimum floor reveal a highly dynamic, rapid, minute-by-minute bimodal oscillation and sub-minute flickering between magnitudes 15.0 and 15.2. At the time of writing, the system remains locked in an unprecedented deep minimum, varying between magnitudes 15.0 and 15.2 for a sustained period exceeding 102 consecutive days. Intensive visual monitoring is ongoing to record the eventual egress recovery profile.
